1.chn: 温度表示物體的冷熱程度，並決定熱傳遞的方向。兩物體接觸時，能量由高温一方傳向低温一方，直到兩者達到熱平衡。內能還取決於物質種類、質量和狀態，因此温度相同的物體，內能可以不同。
1.eng: Temperature describes how hot or cold an object is and determines the direction of heat transfer. When objects at different temperatures are in thermal contact, energy flows from the hotter one to the colder one until thermal equilibrium is reached. Equal temperatures do not imply equal internal energies: material, mass and physical state also matter.

2.chn: 攝氏温標有兩個定點。在標準大氣壓強下，純冰熔化的温度定為 0 °C，稱為冰點。純水沸騰時，上升蒸汽的温度定為 100 °C，稱為汽點。校準時須使用純物質，保持指定壓強，並等候讀數穩定。量度汽點時，温度計放在蒸汽中。
2.eng: The ice point is the temperature of melting pure ice at standard atmospheric pressure, defined as 0 °C. The steam point is the temperature of steam above boiling pure water under the same pressure, defined as 100 °C. Calibration requires the specified pressure, pure substances and steady readings. The steam point is measured in the steam.

3.chn: 温度反映粒子隨機運動的平均動能。温度越高，粒子平均運動越劇烈，但各粒子的速率可以不同。對理想氣體，平均平移動能與開爾文温度成正比。計算這個比例時，温度須用 K。
3.eng: Temperature is related to the average kinetic energy of random particle motion. A higher temperature means more vigorous motion on average, not that every particle has the same speed. For an ideal gas, mean translational kinetic energy is proportional to temperature in kelvin; Celsius values cannot be used directly in this proportionality.

4.chn: 熱是因温差而傳遞的能量，會自然地由高温處傳向低温處。內能則是物體內粒子的動能和相互作用勢能的總和。物體吸熱或放熱時，內能通常會改變。熱表示能量的傳遞過程，內能表示物體本身的能量。
4.eng: Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference, naturally flowing from hot to cold. Internal energy is the total microscopic energy of the particles within an object. Absorbing or releasing heat generally changes internal energy, but heat describes a transfer rather than an amount stored as a property of the object.

5.chn: 傳導是能量從高温處傳向低温處，而物質本身沒有整體流動的過程。粒子間的碰撞或相互作用傳遞能量，金屬中的自由電子亦有重要作用。兩物體直接接觸可傳導熱。
5.eng: Conduction transfers energy from hotter to colder regions without bulk movement of the material. Particle collisions and interactions transfer energy, while free electrons also play an important role in metals. Heat can therefore pass between objects in direct contact.

6.chn: 對流靠液體或氣體的整體流動傳遞能量。自然對流中，流體受熱膨脹，密度減小而上升。較冷、密度較大的流體下沉補位，形成循環。風扇或泵可推動流體，產生強迫對流。固體沒有這種整體流動，因此不能以對流傳熱。
6.eng: Convection transfers energy through bulk movement of a liquid or gas. In natural convection, heated fluid expands, becomes less dense and rises, while cooler, denser fluid sinks to replace it. Fans and pumps produce forced convection. Solids cannot transfer heat by this kind of bulk flow.

7.chn: 熱輻射是物體以電磁波發射和吸收能量的傳熱方式。它不需要介質，可以穿過真空。一般温度下主要涉及紅外線。即使物體比環境冷，仍會發射輻射。如果吸收的功率大於發射的功率，物體便淨吸熱。
7.eng: Objects emit and absorb energy as electromagnetic radiation. This transfer needs no medium and can cross a vacuum. At ordinary temperatures, infrared radiation is especially important. An object colder than its surroundings still emits radiation, but it may absorb more power than it emits and therefore gain energy overall.

8.chn: 在相同温度及可比較條件下，黑色暗啞表面通常是良好的熱輻射吸收體和發射體。淺色光亮表面通常吸收及發射較少、反射較多。比較時須控制表面面積與温度。
8.eng: Under comparable conditions, dull black surfaces are generally good absorbers and emitters of thermal radiation. Light-coloured, shiny surfaces usually absorb and emit less and reflect more. Keep surface area and temperature controlled when comparing surfaces.

9.chn: 物體與環境會互相交換輻射能量。淨輻射傳熱取決於發射功率與吸收功率的差。在表面性質和面積固定、環境條件相同時，温差越大，淨輻射傳熱率的大小通常越大。
9.eng: Objects exchange radiative energy with their surroundings. Net radiative transfer is the difference between emitted and absorbed power. With fixed surface properties and area under the same environmental conditions, a larger temperature difference generally gives a greater magnitude of net radiative heat transfer.

10.chn: 在表面性質、温度和受照條件相同時，面積越大，總發射或吸收功率越大，因為交換能量的表面更多。面積增加改變的是總功率。每單位面積的輻射功率仍由表面性質、温度和受照條件決定。
10.eng: With the same surface properties, temperature and illumination, a larger surface area emits or absorbs more total radiative power. More surface is exchanging energy. Area changes the total power. Power per unit area is determined by surface properties, temperature and illumination.

11.chn: 功率表示每單位時間轉移或轉換多少能量。平均功率用整段時間內的能量除以所需時間。1 W 表示每秒轉移 1 J。相同能量在較短時間內完成，功率較大。若功率隨時間改變，不能把平均值直接當作每一時刻的功率。
11.eng: Power measures energy transferred or converted per unit time. Average power is the total energy transferred divided by the elapsed time; 1 W means 1 J per second. Transferring the same energy in less time requires greater average power. If power varies, this average need not equal the instantaneous power at any chosen moment.

12.chn: 熱容量是整個物體升温 1 K（或 1 °C）所需的能量，取決於物料和質量。吸收相同能量時，熱容量越大，温度升幅越小。如果沒有物態改變，且熱容量近似不變，吸收熱量便等於熱容量乘温度升幅。
12.eng: Heat capacity is the energy needed to raise the temperature of a whole object by 1 K, equivalent to a rise of 1 °C. With no change of state and approximately constant heat capacity, absorbed energy equals heat capacity times temperature rise. A larger heat capacity gives a smaller rise for the same energy input. It depends on both material and mass.

13.chn: 熱容量是整個物體升温 1 K（或 1 °C）所需的能量，取決於物料和質量。吸收相同能量時，熱容量越大，温度升幅越小。如果沒有物態改變，且熱容量近似不變，吸收熱量便等於熱容量乘温度升幅。
13.eng: Heat capacity is the energy needed to raise the temperature of a whole object by 1 K, equivalent to a rise of 1 °C. With no change of state and approximately constant heat capacity, absorbed energy equals heat capacity times temperature rise. A larger heat capacity gives a smaller rise for the same energy input. It depends on both material and mass.

14.chn: 比熱容量是使 1 kg 物質升温 1 K 所需的能量，用來比較不同物料的吸熱能力。整個物體的熱容量等於質量乘比熱容量。同種物料的質量加倍，熱容量也加倍，而比熱容量保持不變。兩者的單位不同。
14.eng: Specific heat capacity is the energy needed to raise 1 kg of a substance by 1 K. The heat capacity of a whole object is its mass multiplied by its specific heat capacity. Doubling the mass of the same material doubles heat capacity but does not change specific heat capacity. The two quantities also have different units.

15.chn: 比熱容量是使 1 kg 物質升温 1 K 所需的能量，用來比較不同物料的吸熱能力。整個物體的熱容量等於質量乘比熱容量。同種物料的質量加倍，熱容量也加倍，而比熱容量保持不變。兩者的單位不同。
15.eng: Specific heat capacity is the energy needed to raise 1 kg of a substance by 1 K. The heat capacity of a whole object is its mass multiplied by its specific heat capacity. Doubling the mass of the same material doubles heat capacity but does not change specific heat capacity. The two quantities also have different units.

16.chn: 沒有物態改變，且比熱容量近似不變時，吸收熱量等於質量、比熱容量和温度升幅的乘積。降温時，可用温度下降的大小求放熱量，也可一致採用帶正負號的温度變化。如果加熱時有能量散失，物體吸收的能量會少於加熱器的輸入。
16.eng: With no change of state and approximately constant specific heat capacity, the absorbed energy is mass times specific heat capacity times temperature rise. For cooling, either calculate released energy using the magnitude of the temperature drop or consistently use signed changes. If energy escapes to the surroundings, not all the heater's input is absorbed by the sample.

17.chn: 把熱物體、冷物體和容器視為同一系統。若沒有外來能量輸入，也沒有向外散熱，熱的一方失去的能量便等於其餘部分吸收的能量。先計算各物體的温度變化及相變能量，再列出能量平衡。容器吸熱和熔化所需的潛熱也須計入。
17.eng: Treat the hot body, cold body and container as one system. With no energy supplied from outside or lost to the surroundings, energy released by the hotter parts equals energy absorbed by the other parts. Calculate each temperature change and any change of state separately. Include the container's heating and any latent heat required.

18.chn: 能量能在物體之間轉移，也能在動能、勢能、內能等形式之間轉化，但不能憑空產生或消失。孤立系統的總能量不變。若選定系統與外界交換能量，就須把輸入和輸出一併計算。摩擦造成機械能減少，仍符合總能量守恆。
18.eng: Energy can be transferred between objects and converted between kinetic, potential, internal and other forms, but cannot be created or destroyed. Total energy remains constant in an isolated system. For a system exchanging energy with its surroundings, include all inputs and outputs. Friction reduces mechanical energy without violating conservation of total energy.

19.chn:
熔化和汽化需要吸收能量，改變粒子的排列或間距。純物質在固定壓強下，於熔點熔化或於沸點沸騰時，温度保持不變，吸收的能量稱為潛熱。相變完成後，繼續加熱才會再升温。

蒸發和沸騰都是液體變成氣體的過程，都需要汽化潛熱。蒸發時，動能較大的分子從液面逃出，使剩餘分子的平均動能下降，液體便冷卻。周圍可向液體補充這部分能量。
19.eng:
Melting and vaporisation absorb energy to change particle arrangements or separation. At fixed pressure, a pure substance stays at constant temperature while melting at its melting point or boiling at its boiling point. The absorbed energy is latent heat. Further heating raises the temperature after the change of state is complete.

Evaporation and boiling both turn liquid into gas and require latent heat of vaporisation. During evaporation, more energetic molecules escape from the surface. The remaining molecules have lower average kinetic energy, so the liquid cools. Its surroundings can supply replacement energy.

20.chn: 凝固和凝結時，物質向環境釋放潛熱。粒子的排列或間距改變，內能降低。純物質在固定壓強下，這段相變過程可保持恆温。同種物質在相同條件下，正、反方向的相變，每公斤吸收和釋放的潛熱大小相同。
20.eng: Freezing and condensation release latent heat to the surroundings as particle arrangements or separations change and internal energy falls. A pure substance can change state at constant temperature under fixed pressure. For the same substance under the same conditions, reverse changes of state absorb and release equal amounts of latent heat per kilogram.

21.chn: 比潛熱是 1 kg 物質在指定條件下改變物態時，吸收或釋放的能量。相變熱量等於實際改變物態的質量乘相應的比潛熱。熔化用熔解比潛熱，汽化用汽化比潛熱。如果物質先升温再相變，兩部分能量須分開計算。
21.eng: Specific latent heat is the energy absorbed or released per kilogram undergoing a specified change of state. Multiply it by the mass actually changing state to obtain the energy transferred. Distinguish fusion from vaporisation. If a sample first warms and then changes state, calculate the temperature-change energy and latent heat separately.

22.chn: 內能包括兩部分：粒子隨機運動的動能，以及粒子相互作用的勢能。把物體內所有粒子的這兩部分能量相加，便得到內能。物體整體運動的動能和整體位置的重力勢能不計在內。升温通常增加粒子的平均動能。相變則可在温度不變時，改變粒子勢能和內能。
22.eng: Internal energy is the sum of the kinetic energies of random microscopic particle motion and the potential energies of particle interactions. It excludes the kinetic energy of the object's bulk motion and its overall gravitational potential energy. Heating usually increases mean particle kinetic energy, whereas a change of state can change internal energy without changing temperature.

23.chn: 壓強表示單位面積受到的垂直作用力。相同力集中在較小面積上，壓強較大。公式使用的是垂直於表面的力分量及實際受力面積。1 Pa 等於每平方米受到 1 N 的垂直力。
23.eng: Pressure is normal force per unit area. The same force concentrated on a smaller area produces greater pressure. Use the component perpendicular to the surface and the actual area over which it acts. One pascal is one newton of normal force per square metre.

24.chn:
固定氣體量及温度時，絕對壓強與體積成反比，所以兩個狀態的壓強與體積乘積相同。體積減半，絕對壓強便加倍。

絕對壓強以真空為零點。若儀表讀數以大氣壓為零點，氣體的絕對壓強等於讀數加當地大氣壓。比較兩個狀態時，氣體量和温度須保持不變。
24.eng:
For a fixed amount of gas at constant temperature, absolute pressure is inversely proportional to volume. The pressure-volume product is therefore unchanged between two states. Halving volume doubles absolute pressure.

Absolute pressure is measured from a vacuum. If a gauge reads pressure relative to the atmosphere, add local atmospheric pressure to obtain absolute pressure. The two-state comparison requires unchanged gas amount and temperature.

25.chn:
固定氣體量及温度時，絕對壓強與體積成反比，所以兩個狀態的壓強與體積乘積相同。體積減半，絕對壓強便加倍。

絕對壓強以真空為零點。若儀表讀數以大氣壓為零點，氣體的絕對壓強等於讀數加當地大氣壓。比較兩個狀態時，氣體量和温度須保持不變。
25.eng:
For a fixed amount of gas at constant temperature, absolute pressure is inversely proportional to volume. The pressure-volume product is therefore unchanged between two states. Halving volume doubles absolute pressure.

Absolute pressure is measured from a vacuum. If a gauge reads pressure relative to the atmosphere, add local atmospheric pressure to obtain absolute pressure. The two-state comparison requires unchanged gas amount and temperature.

26.chn: 開爾文温標以絕對零度為起點。攝氏温度加上 273.15 就得到開爾文數值，課本常取 273。升温 1 K 與升温 1 °C 的温差相同，但兩種温度的比值不同。氣體定律及絕對温度比例關係必須使用 K。
26.eng: The kelvin scale starts at absolute zero. Add 273.15 to the Celsius reading to obtain the kelvin value. The textbook commonly rounds this to 273. A rise of 1 K equals a rise of 1 °C, but ratios of the readings differ. Gas laws and absolute-temperature proportionalities require kelvin.

29.chn: 固定質量的氣體在壓強不變時，體積與開爾文温度成正比。加熱時氣體膨脹，以維持相同壓強。用前後狀態的體積除以絕對温度作比較，不能直接用攝氏數值，也不能套用於氣體洩漏或壓強明顯改變的過程。
29.eng: For a fixed mass of gas at constant pressure, volume is proportional to kelvin temperature. Heating allows the gas to expand while maintaining its pressure. Compare volume divided by absolute temperature in the two states. Do not use Celsius readings directly or apply the relation when gas leaks or pressure changes appreciably.

30.chn: 固定質量的氣體在壓強不變時，體積與開爾文温度成正比。加熱時氣體膨脹，以維持相同壓強。用前後狀態的體積除以絕對温度作比較，不能直接用攝氏數值，也不能套用於氣體洩漏或壓強明顯改變的過程。
30.eng: For a fixed mass of gas at constant pressure, volume is proportional to kelvin temperature. Heating allows the gas to expand while maintaining its pressure. Compare volume divided by absolute temperature in the two states. Do not use Celsius readings directly or apply the relation when gas leaks or pressure changes appreciably.

31.chn: 固定氣體量時，理想氣體的 pV/T 保持不變，可比較壓強、體積和温度同時改變的兩個狀態。p 是以真空為零點的絕對壓強，T 是開爾文温度。兩個狀態的壓強和體積各用一致單位，並確保期間沒有氣體進出。
31.eng: For a fixed amount of ideal gas, pV/T remains constant. This relates two states in which pressure, volume and temperature may all change. Here p is absolute pressure measured from a vacuum and T is temperature in kelvin. Use consistent pressure and volume units between states, with no gas entering or escaping.

32.chn: 固定氣體量時，理想氣體的 pV/T 保持不變，可比較壓強、體積和温度同時改變的兩個狀態。p 是以真空為零點的絕對壓強，T 是開爾文温度。兩個狀態的壓強和體積各用一致單位，並確保期間沒有氣體進出。
32.eng: For a fixed amount of ideal gas, pV/T remains constant. This relates two states in which pressure, volume and temperature may all change. Here p is absolute pressure measured from a vacuum and T is temperature in kelvin. Use consistent pressure and volume units between states, with no gas entering or escaping.

33.chn:
理想氣體方程把絕對壓強 p、體積 V、氣體量 n 和開爾文温度 T 連起來。絕對壓強以真空為零點。採用 SI 氣體常數時，p 用 Pa、V 用 m³、n 用 mol。氣體量改變時，方程仍可分別描述前後的平衡狀態。

摩爾數 \(n=N/N_A=m/M\)：N 是分子總數，N_A 是阿伏伽德羅常數，m 是氣體總質量，M 是摩爾質量。m 和 M 的質量單位須一致，例如都用 g，或都用 kg。
33.eng:
The ideal gas equation connects absolute pressure p, volume V, amount of gas n and kelvin temperature T. Absolute pressure is measured from a vacuum. With the SI gas constant, use Pa, m³ and mol. If gas amount changes, apply the equation separately to the initial and final equilibrium states.

The amount in moles is \(n=N/N_A=m/M\). N is the number of molecules, N_A is the Avogadro constant, m is total gas mass and M is molar mass. Use matching mass units for m and M, such as g with g mol⁻¹ or kg with kg mol⁻¹.

34.chn: 氣體分子不斷隨機運動，撞擊容器壁時動量改變，因而對器壁施力。大量碰撞產生的平均力除以器壁面積，就是氣體壓強。分子數密度增加或平均速率增大，都可使壓強上升。
34.eng: Gas molecules move randomly and change momentum when they collide with container walls, exerting forces on those walls. The mean force from many collisions divided by wall area gives the pressure. Greater molecular number density or greater mean speed can raise pressure. Gas pressure is not caused solely by the gas's weight.

35.chn: 理想氣體模型把同種氣體視為大量質量相同、不斷隨機運動的分子。相比分子間的空間和兩次碰撞間的時間，分子本身的體積及碰撞時間可忽略。除碰撞時外，忽略分子間作用力。分子彼此及與器壁的碰撞均為完全彈性。
35.eng: The ideal-gas model treats a gas as many identical molecules in continuous random motion. Molecular volume is negligible compared with the space between molecules. Collision duration is negligible compared with the time between collisions. Forces between molecules are ignored except during collisions. Collisions between molecules and with walls are perfectly elastic.

36.chn: 氣體動力學把壓強與分子數、單一分子質量和均方速率聯繫起來，描述大量分子碰撞器壁的平均效果。均方速率的求法是先把各分子的速率平方，再取平均。這個模型假設分子的隨機運動在各方向上相同。分子形式的公式使用分子數。
36.eng: Kinetic theory relates gas pressure to the number of molecules, the mass of one molecule and mean square speed. It describes the average effect of many collisions with the walls. To find mean square speed, square each molecular speed and then take the average. The model assumes isotropic random motion, meaning the motion has no preferred direction. The molecular form of the equation uses the number of molecules.

39.chn: 位移是末位置相對初位置的改變，具有大小和方向。路程則把實際走過的路徑長度全部相加。往返原地時位移為零，但路程通常不為零。計算一維位移前先選正方向，末位置減初位置的正負號便表示方向。
39.eng: Displacement is the change from initial to final position and has both magnitude and direction. Distance adds all the lengths along the actual path. Returning to the starting point gives zero displacement but usually non-zero distance. In one dimension, choose a positive direction and subtract initial position from final position. The sign indicates direction.

40.chn: 標量只需要大小，例子有質量、時間、路程和能量。矢量還需要方向，例子有位移、速度、力及動量。合成矢量時必須考慮方向，不能直接把大小相加。一維問題可用正負號表示方向，多維問題則要分解分量。
40.eng: Scalars need magnitude only, such as mass, time, distance and energy. Vectors also need direction, such as displacement, velocity, force and momentum. Vector addition must account for directions rather than simply adding magnitudes. Signs can represent direction in one dimension. In more dimensions, resolve vectors into components.

43.chn: 速度描述位置改變的快慢和方向。平均速度用合位移除以整段經過時間。往返原地時平均速度為零，即使一路都在移動，平均速率仍可非零。計算時須選定正方向或寫明方向。平均速度不一定等於任何一段的瞬時速度。
43.eng: Velocity describes the rate and direction of position change. Average velocity is net displacement divided by total elapsed time. A round trip can have zero average velocity but non-zero average speed. Choose a positive direction or state the direction explicitly. Average velocity need not equal the instantaneous velocity during a particular stage.

44.chn: 速度描述位置改變的快慢和方向。平均速度用合位移除以整段經過時間。往返原地時平均速度為零，即使一路都在移動，平均速率仍可非零。計算時須選定正方向或寫明方向。平均速度不一定等於任何一段的瞬時速度。
44.eng: Velocity describes the rate and direction of position change. Average velocity is net displacement divided by total elapsed time. A round trip can have zero average velocity but non-zero average speed. Choose a positive direction or state the direction explicitly. Average velocity need not equal the instantaneous velocity during a particular stage.

45.chn: 加速度描述速度改變的快慢和方向，平均值用末速度減初速度，再除以經過時間。速度的大小或方向改變都可產生加速度。負加速度只表示朝負方向，並不必然是減速。所有速度應沿同一選定方向帶正負號計算。
45.eng: Average acceleration is final velocity minus initial velocity, divided by elapsed time. A change in speed or direction can cause acceleration. Negative acceleration means acceleration in the chosen negative direction, not necessarily slowing down. Use a consistent sign convention for all velocities before calculating their difference.

47.chn: 百分不確定度等於絕對不確定度除以量度值，再乘 100%，用來比較量度的相對精密程度。在絕對不確定度相同時，量度值越大，百分不確定度越小。分子和分母須用相同單位。若求相對標準值的百分偏差，則以標準值作分母。
47.eng: Percentage uncertainty is absolute uncertainty divided by the measured value, multiplied by 100%. It compares the relative precision of measurements. For the same absolute uncertainty, a larger measured value gives a smaller percentage uncertainty. Use matching units in the numerator and denominator. Percentage deviation from a reference value instead uses the reference value as the denominator.

48.chn: 加速度描述速度改變的快慢和方向，平均值用末速度減初速度，再除以經過時間。速度的大小或方向改變都可產生加速度。負加速度只表示朝負方向，並不必然是減速。所有速度應沿同一選定方向帶正負號計算。
48.eng: Average acceleration is final velocity minus initial velocity, divided by elapsed time. A change in speed or direction can cause acceleration. Negative acceleration means acceleration in the chosen negative direction, not necessarily slowing down. Use a consistent sign convention for all velocities before calculating their difference.

49.chn: 在一維運動中，速度與加速度同方向時速率增加，反方向時速率減少。因此要同時看兩者正負號。負速度配負加速度代表向負方向越走越快。物體瞬間速度為零時仍可有加速度，例如鉛直上拋到最高點。
49.eng: In one dimension, an object speeds up when velocity and acceleration have the same direction and slows down when they oppose each other. Check both signs: negative velocity with negative acceleration means increasing speed in the negative direction. Zero instantaneous velocity does not imply zero acceleration, as at the top of a vertical throw.

50.chn: 位置—時間圖的斜率表示速度：兩點連線的斜率是該段平均速度，曲線某點切線的斜率是瞬時速度。斜率正負表示方向，水平線代表位置不變。曲線的縱座標是位置，不能把它的高低直接當成速度大小。
50.eng: The slope of a position-time graph gives velocity. A secant between two points gives average velocity over the interval. A tangent gives instantaneous velocity. The sign indicates direction, and a horizontal line means unchanged position. The vertical coordinate is position, so a higher point does not itself mean a greater speed.

51.chn: 速度—時間圖的斜率表示加速度。直線斜率固定，代表加速度不變。向上或向下傾斜只表示加速度正負，物體是否加快還要看速度方向。水平線代表速度固定，並不代表物體停下。只有位於時間軸上的水平線才是靜止。
51.eng: The slope of a velocity-time graph gives acceleration. A straight line has constant acceleration. Upward or downward slope indicates the sign of acceleration, but whether the object speeds up also depends on velocity. A horizontal line means constant velocity. The object is at rest only if that line lies on the time axis.

52.chn: 速度—時間圖與時間軸之間的有向面積等於位移：時間軸上方面積取正、下方面積取負。求路程時則將每段面積的大小相加，不能讓正負抵消。規則圖形可直接用三角形或梯形面積。
52.eng: Signed area between a velocity-time graph and the time axis gives displacement: areas above the axis are positive and those below are negative. To find distance travelled, add the magnitudes of the separate areas instead. Triangles and trapezia can be calculated geometrically.

53.chn: 位置—時間圖的斜率給出速度，速度—時間圖的斜率給出加速度。反過來，加速度—時間圖的有向面積給出速度變化，速度—時間圖的有向面積給出位移。面積表示改變量。求實際速度或位置時，須加上初值。時間軸上下的面積分別取正、負值。
53.eng: The slope of position-time gives velocity, and the slope of velocity-time gives acceleration. Conversely, signed area under acceleration-time gives the change in velocity, and signed area under velocity-time gives displacement. Areas give changes only. Add the initial velocity or position when reconstructing actual values and retain the appropriate signs.

54.chn: 勻加速運動方程適用於沿直線、加速度不變的運動。先選正方向，再辨認初速度、末速度、位移和時間，選用所需未知量最少的方程。位移須按方向帶正負號。如果各階段的加速度不同，便分段列式。
54.eng: These equations apply to straight-line motion with constant acceleration. Choose a positive direction, identify initial and final velocities, displacement and time, then select an equation without unnecessary unknowns. Displacement is not distance travelled. If acceleration differs between stages, solve each stage separately rather than treating the whole motion as uniformly accelerated.

55.chn: 地表附近忽略空氣阻力時，不同質量物體都有大小約為 9.81 m s⁻²、鉛直向下的重力加速度。上拋時物體向上而加速度向下，到最高點速度瞬間為零但加速度不為零。選向上為正時，整段飛行的加速度均取負值。
55.eng: Near Earth's surface, neglecting air resistance, objects of different masses have the same downward gravitational acceleration, approximately 9.81 m s⁻². A rising object still accelerates downwards. At its highest point velocity is momentarily zero but acceleration is not. With upwards positive, acceleration is negative throughout the flight.

56.chn: 地表附近忽略空氣阻力時，不同質量物體都有大小約為 9.81 m s⁻²、鉛直向下的重力加速度。上拋時物體向上而加速度向下，到最高點速度瞬間為零但加速度不為零。選向上為正時，整段飛行的加速度均取負值。
56.eng: Near Earth's surface, neglecting air resistance, objects of different masses have the same downward gravitational acceleration, approximately 9.81 m s⁻². A rising object still accelerates downwards. At its highest point velocity is momentarily zero but acceleration is not. With upwards positive, acceleration is negative throughout the flight.

57.chn: 慣性是物體維持靜止或恆速度運動的傾向。質量越大，慣性越大，同樣合力產生的加速度越小。慣性是物體的性質。沒有阻力且合力為零時，物體可以一直保持恆速度運動。
57.eng: Inertia is the tendency to maintain rest or constant velocity. Greater mass means greater inertia, so the same resultant force produces a smaller change in velocity per second. Inertia is a property, not an additional force. Without resistance, no continuing forward resultant force is needed to maintain constant velocity.

58.chn: 慣性是物體維持靜止或恆速度運動的傾向。質量越大，慣性越大，同樣合力產生的加速度越小。慣性是物體的性質。沒有阻力且合力為零時，物體可以一直保持恆速度運動。
58.eng: Inertia is the tendency to maintain rest or constant velocity. Greater mass means greater inertia, so the same resultant force produces a smaller change in velocity per second. Inertia is a property, not an additional force. Without resistance, no continuing forward resultant force is needed to maintain constant velocity.

59.chn: 在課本採用的非加速參考系中，物體所受合力為零時，會保持靜止或沿直線作等速運動。這表示觀察者的參考系本身沒有加速度。力的作用是改變速度；各個力可以互相平衡，使合力為零。
59.eng: In the non-accelerating reference frame used in the textbook, an object with zero resultant force stays at rest or moves at constant velocity in a straight line. The reference frame is the one used by the observer to describe motion. Force changes velocity. Individual forces can balance to give zero resultant force.

60.chn: 質量不變時，物體的加速度由合力決定，方向與合力相同。同一質量受到的合力越大，加速度越大。同一合力作用下，質量越大，加速度越小。計算時先畫受力圖，再按方向合成各個力。
60.eng: For constant mass, acceleration is determined by the resultant force and points in its direction. A greater resultant force gives greater acceleration for the same mass. A larger mass accelerates less under the same force. Draw a free-body diagram and combine all forces with signs before applying the law.

61.chn: 質量不變時，物體的加速度由合力決定，方向與合力相同。同一質量受到的合力越大，加速度越大。同一合力作用下，質量越大，加速度越小。計算時先畫受力圖，再按方向合成各個力。
61.eng: For constant mass, acceleration is determined by the resultant force and points in its direction. A greater resultant force gives greater acceleration for the same mass. A larger mass accelerates less under the same force. Draw a free-body diagram and combine all forces with signs before applying the law.

62.chn: 質量反映慣性，單位是 kg，通常不隨所在地改變。重量是重力場對物體施加的引力，單位是 N，大小等於質量乘當地重力場強度。物體到月球後，質量不變，重量減小。重量有方向。磅量度的是支持力，讀數可能與重量不同。
62.eng: Mass measures inertia, is expressed in kg and normally remains unchanged when location changes. Weight is gravitational force, measured in N, equal to mass times local gravitational field strength. On the Moon, mass is unchanged but weight is smaller. Weight has direction, and a scale's support-force reading need not equal weight.

63.chn: 質量反映慣性，單位是 kg，通常不隨所在地改變。重量是重力場對物體施加的引力，單位是 N，大小等於質量乘當地重力場強度。物體到月球後，質量不變，重量減小。重量有方向。磅量度的是支持力，讀數可能與重量不同。
63.eng: Mass measures inertia, is expressed in kg and normally remains unchanged when location changes. Weight is gravitational force, measured in N, equal to mass times local gravitational field strength. On the Moon, mass is unchanged but weight is smaller. Weight has direction, and a scale's support-force reading need not equal weight.

64.chn: 物體在流體中下落時，速率越大，向上的阻力越大。當阻力與浮力的總和等於重量，合力和加速度便為零，物體以固定的終端速率繼續下落。若浮力可忽略，這個平衡便簡化為阻力等於重量。
64.eng: As an object falls through a fluid, increasing speed raises the upward drag. Terminal speed is reached when drag plus upthrust balances weight, making resultant force and acceleration zero while the object continues falling. Only when upthrust is negligible can the balance be simplified to drag equals weight.

65.chn: 兩物體相互作用時，彼此施加的力大小相等、方向相反、同時出現，並且分別作用於不同物體。這對力不能在單一物體的受力圖中互相抵消。只有把兩物體一併選作系統時，這些內力才在合力相加中抵消。
65.eng: Two interacting objects exert simultaneous forces of equal magnitude and opposite direction on each other. The forces act on different objects, so they do not cancel in one object's free-body diagram. They cancel as internal forces only when both objects are included in a single system.

66.chn:
先畫出各物體的自由體圖，再選擇整體或逐個分析。若幾個物體一起沿同一直線運動，並有相同加速度，可先把它們當成一個系統：內部作用力互相抵消，利用外力和總質量求加速度，再分析單一物體求張力或接觸力。

若物體由不可伸長的繩跨過滑輪連接，它們可有相同的加速度大小，但方向不同。分別沿各物體運動方向選正方向、列方程，再按繩的約束關係聯立。理想的輕繩及無摩擦滑輪模型中，同一條繩的張力相同。
66.eng:
Draw a free-body diagram for each object before choosing a whole-system or individual-body method. Bodies moving together along the same line with the same acceleration can be treated as one system. Internal forces cancel, so external force and total mass give acceleration. Then analyse one body to find tension or contact force.

Bodies connected by an inextensible string over a pulley may have equal acceleration magnitudes in different directions. Choose an axis for each body, write its force equation and combine the equations using the string constraint. The same string has equal tension in the ideal light-string, frictionless-pulley model.

67.chn: 一個斜向力可分解為互相垂直的水平和鉛直分量，兩分量合起來的效果等同原力。若角度從正 x 軸量起，鄰邊分量用餘弦、對邊用正弦。若角度改從鉛直量起，兩者便交換。分量要按所選軸保留方向及正負。
67.eng: A force can be replaced by perpendicular components with the same combined effect. If its angle is measured from the positive x-axis, the adjacent component uses cosine and the opposite component uses sine. Measuring from the vertical interchanges these roles. Assign signs according to the chosen axes and each component's direction.

68.chn: 力矩表示力使物體繞支點轉動的作用。大小等於力乘垂直力臂。垂直力臂是支點到力的作用線的垂直距離。力越大或力臂越長，力矩越大。也可用垂直於支點至作用點連線的力分量計算。方向須註明順時針或逆時針。
68.eng: A moment measures a force's turning effect about a pivot. Its magnitude is force times the perpendicular distance from the pivot to the force's line of action. Equivalently, use the perpendicular force component times the distance to the application point. An arbitrary sloping distance is not the lever arm. State whether the moment is clockwise or anticlockwise.

69.chn: 力矩表示力使物體繞支點轉動的作用。大小等於力乘垂直力臂。垂直力臂是支點到力的作用線的垂直距離。力越大或力臂越長，力矩越大。也可用垂直於支點至作用點連線的力分量計算。方向須註明順時針或逆時針。
69.eng: A moment measures a force's turning effect about a pivot. Its magnitude is force times the perpendicular distance from the pivot to the force's line of action. Equivalently, use the perpendicular force component times the distance to the application point. An arbitrary sloping distance is not the lever arm. State whether the moment is clockwise or anticlockwise.

70.chn: 力矩表示力使物體繞支點轉動的作用。大小等於力乘垂直力臂。垂直力臂是支點到力的作用線的垂直距離。力越大或力臂越長，力矩越大。也可用垂直於支點至作用點連線的力分量計算。方向須註明順時針或逆時針。
70.eng: A moment measures a force's turning effect about a pivot. Its magnitude is force times the perpendicular distance from the pivot to the force's line of action. Equivalently, use the perpendicular force component times the distance to the application point. An arbitrary sloping distance is not the lever arm. State whether the moment is clockwise or anticlockwise.

71.chn: 剛體平衡須同時滿足合力為零及合力矩為零，分別排除平移加速度和轉動加速度。列式時把各方向力分開，再選方便的支點計算力矩。通過支點的力力矩為零，但它仍須列入合力方程。
71.eng: Equilibrium requires both zero resultant force and zero resultant moment, excluding translational and angular acceleration respectively. Resolve forces along suitable axes and choose a convenient pivot for moments. A force through the pivot contributes no moment about it, but must still appear in the force-balance equations.

72.chn: 重心是物體重量的合力作用點。在均勻重力場中，可從重心畫出鉛直向下的重量，並據此計算重力力矩。重心的鉛直投影在支承範圍內，物體可保持穩定。超出範圍便會傾倒。降低重心或擴大底座，通常可提高穩定性。
72.eng: The centre of gravity is the point through which the resultant weight can be treated as acting. In a uniform gravitational field, draw the weight vertically downwards from this point when calculating moments. Toppling depends on whether its vertical projection lies within the support base. A lower centre of gravity and wider base generally improve stability.

73.chn: 力在物體發生位移時可轉移能量，但只有沿位移方向的力分量做功。同向分量做正功、反向分量做負功，垂直於位移的力不做功。有力但沒有位移，也不會做這種機械功。恆力公式使用的是力與位移的夾角。
73.eng: A force transfers mechanical energy through displacement, but only its component along the displacement does work. A component in the same direction does positive work. An opposing one does negative work. A perpendicular force does none. Force without displacement also does no such mechanical work. The constant-force formula uses the angle between force and displacement.

74.chn: 力在物體發生位移時可轉移能量，但只有沿位移方向的力分量做功。同向分量做正功、反向分量做負功，垂直於位移的力不做功。有力但沒有位移，也不會做這種機械功。恆力公式使用的是力與位移的夾角。
74.eng: A force transfers mechanical energy through displacement, but only its component along the displacement does work. A component in the same direction does positive work. An opposing one does negative work. A perpendicular force does none. Force without displacement also does no such mechanical work. The constant-force formula uses the angle between force and displacement.

75.chn: 力在物體發生位移時可轉移能量，但只有沿位移方向的力分量做功。同向分量做正功、反向分量做負功，垂直於位移的力不做功。有力但沒有位移，也不會做這種機械功。恆力公式使用的是力與位移的夾角。
75.eng: A force transfers mechanical energy through displacement, but only its component along the displacement does work. A component in the same direction does positive work. An opposing one does negative work. A perpendicular force does none. Force without displacement also does no such mechanical work. The constant-force formula uses the angle between force and displacement.

76.chn: 當 1 N 的力使物體沿該力方向移動 1 m，力做的功為 1 J。功是能量轉移，所以與能量使用同一單位。雖然力矩的單位也可寫成 N m，它表示轉動作用而不是能量，通常不把力矩寫成 J。
76.eng: A force of 1 N moving its application point 1 m in the force's direction does 1 J of work. Work is energy transfer, so both use joules. Although moment can also be expressed in N m, it describes turning effect rather than energy and is not normally expressed in joules.

77.chn: 動能是物體因運動而具有的能量，平移動能與質量成正比、與速率平方成正比。速率加倍時動能變成四倍，而改變運動方向但保持速率不會改變動能。動能是非負標量。此公式適用於速率遠低於光速的情況。
77.eng: Translational kinetic energy is energy due to motion, proportional to mass and the square of speed. Doubling speed quadruples kinetic energy. Changing direction alone while keeping speed fixed does not change it. Kinetic energy is a non-negative scalar. The classical expression applies at speeds much lower than the speed of light.

78.chn: 近地面的重力場近似均勻。物體升高時，重力勢能的增加量等於重量乘鉛直高度增加量。勢能零點可自行選擇，但同一題須一致。高度差要量鉛直距離。下降時，重力勢能減少，可轉化為動能或其他形式的能量。
78.eng: Near Earth's surface in an approximately uniform field, raising an object increases gravitational potential energy by its weight times its vertical height increase. The zero level is arbitrary but must remain consistent within a problem. Use vertical height, not slope length or path length. During descent, lost potential energy can become kinetic or other forms of energy.

79.chn: 近地面的重力場近似均勻。物體升高時，重力勢能的增加量等於重量乘鉛直高度增加量。勢能零點可自行選擇，但同一題須一致。高度差要量鉛直距離。下降時，重力勢能減少，可轉化為動能或其他形式的能量。
79.eng: Near Earth's surface in an approximately uniform field, raising an object increases gravitational potential energy by its weight times its vertical height increase. The zero level is arbitrary but must remain consistent within a problem. Use vertical height, not slope length or path length. During descent, lost potential energy can become kinetic or other forms of energy.

80.chn: 能量能在物體之間轉移，也能在動能、勢能、內能等形式之間轉化，但不能憑空產生或消失。孤立系統的總能量不變。若選定系統與外界交換能量，就須把輸入和輸出一併計算。摩擦造成機械能減少，仍符合總能量守恆。
80.eng: Energy can be transferred between objects and converted between kinetic, potential, internal and other forms, but cannot be created or destroyed. Total energy remains constant in an isolated system. For a system exchanging energy with its surroundings, include all inputs and outputs. Friction reduces mechanical energy without violating conservation of total energy.

81.chn:
機械能是動能與勢能之和，勢能可包括重力勢能和彈性勢能。只有這些能量互相轉換、而沒有其他能量輸入或散失時，初末機械能相等。

下落時，重力勢能可轉為動能；拉長彈性繩或壓縮彈簧時，能量可儲存為彈性勢能。若摩擦、空氣阻力或引擎造成其他能量轉移，應把這部分計入能量收支。
81.eng:
Mechanical energy is kinetic plus potential energy. Potential energy can include gravitational and elastic forms. Initial and final mechanical energies are equal when these forms only convert into one another, with no other energy input or loss.

Falling can convert gravitational potential energy to kinetic energy. Stretching an elastic cord or compressing a spring can store elastic potential energy. Include any additional energy transferred by friction, air resistance or an engine in the energy balance.

82.chn: 物體克服阻力運動時，一部分機械能轉為內能等形式。若沒有其他輸入，初機械能等於末機械能加上這部分損失。公式中的損失量取正值，與阻力對物體所做的負功大小相同。總能量並未消失。
82.eng: Motion against resistance converts some mechanical energy into internal or other forms. With no other input, initial mechanical energy equals final mechanical energy plus this loss. The loss is written as a positive amount, equal in magnitude to the negative work done by resistance. Total energy is not destroyed.

83.chn:
先選定研究的物體或系統，把重力等作用所對應的能量計入勢能。其餘力所做的淨功 W_ext，等於機械能的改變：正功令機械能增加，負功令機械能減少。

例如引擎做正功可增加機械能，摩擦做負功可把機械能轉為內能。採用重力勢能計算時，重力的能量轉移已包含在勢能變化內。
83.eng:
First choose the object or system and include gravitational and other relevant stored energies as potential energy. The net work W_ext of the remaining forces equals the change in mechanical energy. Positive work increases it and negative work decreases it.

For example, an engine can increase mechanical energy, while friction can convert it to internal energy. When gravitational potential energy is used, the energy transferred by gravity is already included in its change.

84.chn: 功率表示每單位時間轉移或轉換多少能量。平均功率用整段時間內的能量除以所需時間。1 W 表示每秒轉移 1 J。相同能量在較短時間內完成，功率較大。若功率隨時間改變，不能把平均值直接當作每一時刻的功率。
84.eng: Power measures energy transferred or converted per unit time. Average power is the total energy transferred divided by the elapsed time; 1 W means 1 J per second. Transferring the same energy in less time requires greater average power. If power varies, this average need not equal the instantaneous power at any chosen moment.

85.chn: 某力的瞬時功率，等於它沿速度方向的分量乘當時的速率。力與速度同方向時，直接相乘。互相垂直時，功率為零。反方向時，功率為負。求某一時刻的功率，須用該時刻的速率。
85.eng: The instantaneous power of a force is its component along the velocity multiplied by the instantaneous speed. Parallel force and velocity give their simple product. Perpendicular force gives zero power and opposing force gives negative power. An average speed over an interval cannot generally replace the instantaneous speed when finding power at a particular moment.

86.chn: 動能是物體因運動而具有的能量，平移動能與質量成正比、與速率平方成正比。速率加倍時動能變成四倍，而改變運動方向但保持速率不會改變動能。動能是非負標量。此公式適用於速率遠低於光速的情況。
86.eng: Translational kinetic energy is energy due to motion, proportional to mass and the square of speed. Doubling speed quadruples kinetic energy. Changing direction alone while keeping speed fixed does not change it. Kinetic energy is a non-negative scalar. The classical expression applies at speeds much lower than the speed of light.

87.chn: 近地面的重力場近似均勻。物體升高時，重力勢能的增加量等於重量乘鉛直高度增加量。勢能零點可自行選擇，但同一題須一致。高度差要量鉛直距離。下降時，重力勢能減少，可轉化為動能或其他形式的能量。
87.eng: Near Earth's surface in an approximately uniform field, raising an object increases gravitational potential energy by its weight times its vertical height increase. The zero level is arbitrary but must remain consistent within a problem. Use vertical height, not slope length or path length. During descent, lost potential energy can become kinetic or other forms of energy.

88.chn: 某力的瞬時功率，等於它沿速度方向的分量乘當時的速率。力與速度同方向時，直接相乘。互相垂直時，功率為零。反方向時，功率為負。求某一時刻的功率，須用該時刻的速率。
88.eng: The instantaneous power of a force is its component along the velocity multiplied by the instantaneous speed. Parallel force and velocity give their simple product. Perpendicular force gives zero power and opposing force gives negative power. An average speed over an interval cannot generally replace the instantaneous speed when finding power at a particular moment.

89.chn: 動量是質量乘速度的矢量，方向與速度一致。同速率下質量越大，動量大小越大。比較碰撞前後時，先選正方向，反向運動的速度及動量取負值。動量不是動能：動量與速度一次方有關，動能則與速率平方有關。
89.eng: Momentum is mass times velocity and is a vector in the velocity's direction. At the same speed, greater mass gives greater momentum magnitude. Choose a positive direction before comparing collisions and assign negative signs to motion in the opposite direction. Unlike kinetic energy, momentum depends on velocity to the first power rather than speed squared.

90.chn: 系統在相互作用期間若外界合衝量為零，碰撞或分離前後的總動量相同。選定系統後，按同一正方向把各物體動量作代數相加。黏在一起時末速度相同。動量守恆可用於彈性及非彈性碰撞，並不保證動能也守恆。
90.eng: A system's total momentum is unchanged during an interaction if the net external impulse is zero. Add the signed momenta of all included objects using one direction convention. Objects sticking together share a final velocity. Momentum conservation applies to both elastic and inelastic collisions and does not imply conservation of kinetic energy.

91.chn: 系統在相互作用期間若外界合衝量為零，碰撞或分離前後的總動量相同。選定系統後，按同一正方向把各物體動量作代數相加。黏在一起時末速度相同。動量守恆可用於彈性及非彈性碰撞，並不保證動能也守恆。
91.eng: A system's total momentum is unchanged during an interaction if the net external impulse is zero. Add the signed momenta of all included objects using one direction convention. Objects sticking together share a final velocity. Momentum conservation applies to both elastic and inelastic collisions and does not imply conservation of kinetic energy.

92.chn: 彈性碰撞前後，總動能相同。非彈性碰撞中，部分動能轉為形變、內能或聲能。完全非彈性碰撞後，物體會黏在一起。如果外界合衝量可忽略，這兩類碰撞的總動量均保持不變。
92.eng: An elastic collision preserves total kinetic energy. In an inelastic collision, some kinetic energy becomes deformation, internal energy or sound. In a completely inelastic collision the objects stick together. Both conserve momentum when external impulse is negligible.

93.chn: 合力等於動量的變化率。對一段作用時間，平均合力可由末動量減初動量，再除以時間得到。反彈時初末速度方向相反，必須帶符號相減。相同動量改變若在較長時間完成，平均合力較小，這是緩衝裝置減小衝擊的原因。
93.eng: Resultant force is the rate of change of momentum. Over an interval, average resultant force equals final minus initial momentum divided by elapsed time. Use signed velocities when an object rebounds. For the same momentum change, increasing the interaction time reduces the average force, explaining how cushioning reduces impact force.

94.chn: 合力等於動量的變化率。對一段作用時間，平均合力可由末動量減初動量，再除以時間得到。反彈時初末速度方向相反，必須帶符號相減。相同動量改變若在較長時間完成，平均合力較小，這是緩衝裝置減小衝擊的原因。
94.eng: Resultant force is the rate of change of momentum. Over an interval, average resultant force equals final minus initial momentum divided by elapsed time. Use signed velocities when an object rebounds. For the same momentum change, increasing the interaction time reduces the average force, explaining how cushioning reduces impact force.

95.chn: 合力在一段時間內的衝量等於物體動量的改變，也等於合力—時間圖與時間軸之間的有向面積。力不恆定時可由圖形面積求衝量，再除以時間求平均力。正負面積表示不同方向，單位 N s 與 kg m s⁻¹ 相同。
95.eng: The impulse of the resultant force equals the change in momentum and the signed area under the resultant-force-time graph. For a varying force, find impulse from the graph and divide by duration to obtain average force. Positive and negative areas represent opposite directions; N s is equivalent to kg m s⁻¹.

96.chn:
忽略空氣阻力時，拋射物只受向下的重力加速度。水平方向速度不變，鉛直方向作等加速度運動；兩個方向共用同一時間 t。

初速 u 與水平成 θ 角時，\(u_x=u\cos\theta\)，\(u_y=u\sin\theta\)。以起點為原點、向上為正，可用 \(x=u_xt\) 及 \(y=u_yt-\frac12gt^2\) 分別求位置。到最高點時，鉛直速度為零，水平速度仍為 u_x，加速度仍向下。
96.eng:
Neglecting air resistance, a projectile has only downward gravitational acceleration. Horizontal velocity stays constant and vertical motion has constant acceleration. Both components share the same elapsed time t.

For launch speed u at angle θ above the horizontal, \(u_x=u\cos\theta\) and \(u_y=u\sin\theta\). Taking the launch point as the origin and upwards as positive gives \(x=u_xt\) and \(y=u_yt-\frac12gt^2\). At the highest point, vertical velocity is zero, horizontal velocity remains u_x and acceleration still points downwards.

97.chn: 角位移描述繞圓心轉過的角度，弧度數等於所掃弧長除以半徑。一整圈為 2π rad。用弧長關係或圓周運動公式時須把角度換成弧度。不同半徑上轉過相同角度，弧長不同，不能把角位移當成直線位移。
97.eng: Angular displacement describes rotation about a centre. In radians it equals arc length divided by radius, with one complete turn equal to 2π rad. Convert angles to radians when using arc-length or circular-motion equations. The same angle at different radii gives different arc lengths, so angular and linear displacement are not interchangeable.

98.chn: 角速率描述每秒轉過多少弧度，線速率描述沿圓周每秒走多遠。同一角速率下，半徑越大，線速率越大。勻速圓周運動一圈走 2πr、轉 2π rad，因此可由一圈所需的週期換算兩種速率，並留意各自單位不同。
98.eng: Angular speed is the angle in radians swept out per second. Linear speed is distance travelled along the circle per second. At fixed angular speed, a larger radius gives greater linear speed. A complete uniform revolution covers 2πr and 2π rad, allowing both speeds to be found from the period. Their units differ.

99.chn: 角速率描述每秒轉過多少弧度，線速率描述沿圓周每秒走多遠。同一角速率下，半徑越大，線速率越大。勻速圓周運動一圈走 2πr、轉 2π rad，因此可由一圈所需的週期換算兩種速率，並留意各自單位不同。
99.eng: Angular speed is the angle in radians swept out per second. Linear speed is distance travelled along the circle per second. At fixed angular speed, a larger radius gives greater linear speed. A complete uniform revolution covers 2πr and 2π rad, allowing both speeds to be found from the period. Their units differ.

At fixed angular speed, a larger radius gives greater linear speed. A complete uniform revolution covers 2πr and 2π rad, allowing both speeds to be found from the period. Their units differ.

101.chn: 勻速圓周運動的速率不變，速度方向卻持續改變，因此有指向圓心的加速度。提供這個加速度的徑向合力稱為向心力，由張力、重力或摩擦力等實際作用力合成。畫受力圖時，只畫實際作用力，再求它們的徑向合力。
101.eng: In uniform circular motion, speed is constant but velocity continually changes direction. The acceleration therefore points towards the centre. The required radial resultant is called centripetal force. It is supplied by real forces such as tension, gravity or friction. Draw the real forces in the free-body diagram, then find their radial resultant.

102.chn: 勻速圓周運動的速率不變，速度方向卻持續改變，因此有指向圓心的加速度。提供這個加速度的徑向合力稱為向心力，由張力、重力或摩擦力等實際作用力合成。畫受力圖時，只畫實際作用力，再求它們的徑向合力。
102.eng: In uniform circular motion, speed is constant but velocity continually changes direction. The acceleration therefore points towards the centre. The required radial resultant is called centripetal force. It is supplied by real forces such as tension, gravity or friction. Draw the real forces in the free-body diagram, then find their radial resultant.

103.chn: 兩個質量互相吸引，引力大小與兩質量的乘積成正比，與中心距離的平方成反比。雙方受力大小相同、方向相反。此簡式適用於質點或不重疊的球對稱物體。距離要從中心量，不是表面距離，也不是單純離地高度。
103.eng: Two masses attract with a force proportional to their mass product and inversely proportional to the square of their centre-to-centre separation. Their forces are equal and opposite. The simple expression applies to point masses or non-overlapping spherically symmetric bodies. Use centre separation, not surface separation or altitude alone.

104.chn: 重力場強度是單位測試質量所受的引力，方向與重力相同，數值等於當地自由落體加速度。在球對稱天體外，離中心越遠，場強越小，並與中心距離的平方成反比。場強與測試物體的質量無關。高空的中心距離等於天體半徑加高度。
104.eng: Gravitational field strength is force per unit test mass. It points in the direction of gravitational force and is numerically equal to local free-fall acceleration. Outside a spherical body, it decreases with the square of distance from the centre. It is independent of the test mass. At altitude, the distance from the centre is the body's radius plus the height above its surface.

Outside a spherical body, it decreases with the square of distance from the centre. It is independent of the test mass. At altitude, the distance from the centre is the body's radius plus the height above its surface.

107.chn:
無動力的圓軌道中，引力提供衞星所需的向心合力。把引力和向心力的表達式相等，可求軌道速率和角速度。同一中心天體周圍，軌道半徑越大，速率和角速度越小，週期越長。半徑由天體中心量起。

地球同步靜止衞星在赤道平面內作圓周運動，轉動方向與地球自轉相同，週期等於地球自轉週期，約 24 小時。因此，它相對地面的同一位置保持靜止。計算時，軌道半徑是地球半徑加衞星高度。
107.eng:
In an unpowered circular orbit, gravity supplies the satellite's centripetal resultant force. Equating the two expressions gives orbital speed and angular speed. Around the same central body, a larger radius gives lower speed and angular speed but a longer period. Measure radius from the body's centre.

A geostationary satellite follows a circular orbit in Earth's equatorial plane, in the same direction as Earth's rotation, with the same rotation period of about 24 hours. It therefore stays above the same ground position. Orbital radius is Earth's radius plus the satellite's altitude.

108.chn:
無動力的圓軌道中，引力提供衞星所需的向心合力。把引力和向心力的表達式相等，可求軌道速率和角速度。同一中心天體周圍，軌道半徑越大，速率和角速度越小，週期越長。半徑由天體中心量起。

地球同步靜止衞星在赤道平面內作圓周運動，轉動方向與地球自轉相同，週期等於地球自轉週期，約 24 小時。因此，它相對地面的同一位置保持靜止。計算時，軌道半徑是地球半徑加衞星高度。

Around the same central body, a larger radius gives lower speed and angular speed but a longer period. Measure radius from the body's centre.

109.chn:
入射光線、反射光線和法線在同一平面內，反射角等於入射角。兩個角都由法線量起。曲面或粗糙面上，應使用入射點的局部法線。

光滑面上，各點法線方向相近，平行入射光反射後仍平行，可形成清晰的像。粗糙面上，各點法線方向不同，光便反射至不同方向，形成漫反射。每條光線仍遵守反射定律。
109.eng:
The incident ray, reflected ray and normal lie in one plane. The angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence, with both measured from the normal. On a curved or rough surface, use the local normal at the incidence point.

On a smooth surface, similarly directed normals keep parallel incident rays parallel after reflection, allowing a clear image. On a rough surface, the normals vary, so rays reflect in different directions. This is diffuse reflection, and each ray still obeys the laws of reflection.

110.chn: 平面鏡形成正立、等大、左右橫向倒置的虛像，像位於鏡後，與鏡面的垂直距離等於物體到鏡面的垂直距離。反射光線並沒有真正穿過鏡後的像點，而是其反向延長線相交，所以此像不能投射到屏幕上。
110.eng: A plane mirror forms an upright, same-sized, laterally inverted virtual image. Its perpendicular distance behind the mirror equals the object's perpendicular distance in front. Reflected rays do not actually pass through the image point. Only their backward extensions meet there, so the image cannot be projected onto a screen.

111.chn: 光進入另一介質時，速率會改變。斜入射進入光速較慢、折射率較高的介質，光線偏向法線。反之則偏離法線。入射角和折射角均由法線量度，並滿足斯涅爾定律。正入射時，速率可改變而方向不變。跨越界面時，頻率保持不變。
111.eng: Light changes speed between media. At oblique incidence it bends towards the normal on entering a slower, higher-index medium, and away on entering a faster one. Snell's law relates the angles, both measured from the normal. At normal incidence the speed can change without a change in direction. Frequency remains unchanged across the boundary.

Snell's law relates the angles, both measured from the normal. At normal incidence the speed can change without a change in direction. Frequency remains unchanged across the boundary.

115.chn: 折射率是真空光速除以該頻率的光在介質中的速率，因此折射率越高，光速越低。折射率沒有單位，且可隨波長改變。光由一介質進入另一介質時頻率不變，波長則隨速率改變。空氣折射率在一般題目中近似為 1。
115.eng: Refractive index is vacuum light speed divided by light speed in the medium at the specified frequency. A higher index therefore means slower light. Index is dimensionless and can depend on wavelength. Across a boundary, frequency remains constant while wavelength changes with speed. Air is normally approximated as having index 1.

117.chn: 光由較高折射率介質射向較低折射率介質時，入射角越大，折射光越接近界面。折射角達 90° 時，對應的入射角稱為臨界角，此時折射光沿界面傳播。入射角再增大，便發生全內反射。所有角度均由法線量起。
117.eng: For light travelling from higher to lower refractive index, increasing incidence angle brings the refracted ray closer to the boundary. The critical angle gives a refracted angle of 90°. Total internal reflection occurs only above this critical angle. At equality, the refracted ray runs along the boundary. All angles are measured from the normal.

118.chn: 光由較高折射率介質射向較低折射率介質時，入射角越大，折射光越接近界面。折射角達 90° 時，對應的入射角稱為臨界角，此時折射光沿界面傳播。入射角再增大，便發生全內反射。所有角度均由法線量起。
118.eng: For light travelling from higher to lower refractive index, increasing incidence angle brings the refracted ray closer to the boundary. The critical angle gives a refracted angle of 90°. Total internal reflection occurs only above this critical angle. At equality, the refracted ray runs along the boundary. All angles are measured from the normal.

119.chn: 實像由光線真正會聚形成，可用屏幕承接。虛像由光線的反向延長線相交形成，光線並未通過像點，不能直接投到屏幕上。眼睛仍可看見虛像，因為入眼光線看起來像由該位置發出。
119.eng: A real image is formed by actual convergence of rays and can be captured on a screen. A virtual image is formed where backward ray extensions meet. The rays do not pass through it, so it cannot be directly projected. Virtual images are still visible because light entering the eye appears to originate from their positions.

120.chn:
對實物而言，凸透鏡成像取決於物距 u 和焦距 f。u > f 時形成倒立實像：u > 2f 時縮小，u = 2f 時等大，f < u < 2f 時放大。u < f 時，在物體同側形成正立放大虛像。u = f 時，出射光平行，像不在有限距離形成。

作圖可從同一物點選取下面三條主光線中的兩條。斜向平行光會會聚在另一側的焦平面，即通過焦點、垂直於主軸的平面。

同一物點的光可經透鏡不同部分到達同一像點。遮住半個透鏡後，整個像仍在原位置，但通過的光減少，像會變暗。
120.eng:
For a real object, a convex lens's image depends on object distance u and focal length f. When u > f, the image is real and inverted: diminished for u > 2f, equal-sized at u = 2f and enlarged for f < u < 2f. For u < f, it is virtual, upright and enlarged on the object side. At u = f, emerging rays are parallel and no finite-distance image forms.

Draw any two of the three principal rays below from the same object point. Oblique parallel rays meet in the far focal plane: the plane through the focus perpendicular to the principal axis.

Light from one object point can pass through different parts of the lens to reach the same image point. Covering half the lens leaves the whole image at the same position, but makes it dimmer because less light passes through.

121.chn: 線放大率比較像高與物高，也可用像距大小與實物距的比值求得。大於 1 為放大，小於 1 為縮小。此卡採用大小比值，所以放大率非負，像的正倒立須另行説明。
121.eng: Linear magnification compares image height with object height and can also be obtained from the magnitudes of image distance and real-object distance. Values above 1 mean enlargement and below 1 mean reduction. This card uses a non-negative size ratio, so orientation is stated separately.

122.chn: 凹透鏡使入射光束更發散。對放在鏡前的實物，出射線的反向延長線在物體同側相交，形成正立、縮小的虛像。作圖可用平行主軸的光線及穿過光心的光線求像。虛像位置通常在透鏡與近側焦點之間。
122.eng: A concave lens diverges incident light. For a real object in front, backward extensions of emerging rays meet on the object's side, forming an upright, diminished virtual image between the lens and its near focal point. Use a ray parallel to the principal axis and a ray through the optical centre to locate it.

123.chn: 凹透鏡使入射光束更發散。對放在鏡前的實物，出射線的反向延長線在物體同側相交，形成正立、縮小的虛像。作圖可用平行主軸的光線及穿過光心的光線求像。虛像位置通常在透鏡與近側焦點之間。
123.eng: A concave lens diverges incident light. For a real object in front, backward extensions of emerging rays meet on the object's side, forming an upright, diminished virtual image between the lens and its near focal point. Use a ray parallel to the principal axis and a ray through the optical centre to locate it.

124.chn: 薄透鏡方程描述物距、像距和焦距的關係，適用於近軸光線。本頁採用以下符號：實物距和實像距為正，虛像距為負。凸透鏡焦距為正，凹透鏡焦距為負。先判斷成像性質，再確定符號，統一距離單位後代入。物體在無限遠時，物距的倒數取零。
124.eng: The thin-lens equation relates object distance, image distance and focal length for paraxial rays. This page takes real-object and real-image distances as positive, and virtual-image distance as negative. Focal length is positive for a convex lens and negative for a concave lens. Decide the image type and signs, then use consistent length units before substitution. For an object at infinity, reciprocal object distance is zero.

125.chn: 機械波傳播時，介質粒子在平衡位置附近振動，把能量傳向鄰近位置。粒子本身留在原位置附近。橫波的振動方向與傳播方向垂直，縱波則平行。縱波的位移也可畫成上下起伏的曲線。曲線表示位移大小，粒子仍沿傳播方向來回振動。
125.eng: In a mechanical wave, particles oscillate near their equilibrium positions and transfer energy to neighbouring regions rather than travelling along with the waveform. Transverse vibrations are perpendicular to propagation. Longitudinal vibrations are parallel. An up-and-down plot of longitudinal displacement does not mean the particles themselves move vertically.

126.chn: 機械波傳播時，介質粒子在平衡位置附近振動，把能量傳向鄰近位置。粒子本身留在原位置附近。橫波的振動方向與傳播方向垂直，縱波則平行。縱波的位移也可畫成上下起伏的曲線。曲線表示位移大小，粒子仍沿傳播方向來回振動。
126.eng: In a mechanical wave, particles oscillate near their equilibrium positions and transfer energy to neighbouring regions rather than travelling along with the waveform. Transverse vibrations are perpendicular to propagation. Longitudinal vibrations are parallel. An up-and-down plot of longitudinal displacement does not mean the particles themselves move vertically.

127.chn: 振幅是粒子離開平衡位置的最大位移，單位為長度。在橫波圖上，可由平衡線到波峯或波谷量得。波峯到波谷的高度是兩倍振幅，不能直接當成振幅。振幅描述振動大小，不決定波長或粒子沿傳播方向走了多遠。
127.eng: Amplitude is the maximum displacement from equilibrium and has units of length. On a transverse-wave plot, measure from the equilibrium line to a crest or trough. Crest-to-trough height is twice the amplitude. Amplitude measures oscillation size, not wavelength or how far a particle travels along the propagation direction.

128.chn:
波長是同一時刻、沿傳播方向相鄰兩個同相點的最短距離，例如相鄰波峰、波谷或密部中心之間的距離。相鄰波峰與波谷相距半個波長。

同相表示在振動週期中處於相同階段：對仍在振動的粒子，要同時比較位移和振動方向。同相粒子會一起向同一方向通過平衡位置，亦會一起到達同一側的最大位移。
128.eng:
Wavelength is the shortest separation along propagation between adjacent points in phase at the same instant, such as neighbouring crests, troughs or compression centres. A crest and the next trough are half a wavelength apart.

In-phase particles are at the same stage of their oscillation cycle. Compare both displacement and direction of motion. They cross equilibrium in the same direction together and reach maximum displacement on the same side together.

129.chn: 週期是一個粒子完成一次完整振動所需的時間，頻率是一秒內完成的振動次數，兩者互為倒數。週期用 s，頻率用 Hz。讀位移—時間圖時可量相鄰波峯的時間差。不要把距離圖上的相鄰波峯間距誤作週期。
129.eng: Period is the time for one complete oscillation. Frequency is the number of oscillations per second. They are reciprocals, measured in s and Hz respectively. On a displacement-time graph, the time between adjacent crests gives period. The separation between crests on a distance graph instead gives wavelength.

130.chn: 週期是一個粒子完成一次完整振動所需的時間，頻率是一秒內完成的振動次數，兩者互為倒數。週期用 s，頻率用 Hz。讀位移—時間圖時可量相鄰波峯的時間差。不要把距離圖上的相鄰波峯間距誤作週期。
130.eng: Period is the time for one complete oscillation. Frequency is the number of oscillations per second. They are reciprocals, measured in s and Hz respectively. On a displacement-time graph, the time between adjacent crests gives period. The separation between crests on a distance graph instead gives wavelength.

131.chn: 週期是一個粒子完成一次完整振動所需的時間，頻率是一秒內完成的振動次數，兩者互為倒數。週期用 s，頻率用 Hz。讀位移—時間圖時可量相鄰波峯的時間差。不要把距離圖上的相鄰波峯間距誤作週期。
131.eng: Period is the time for one complete oscillation. Frequency is the number of oscillations per second. They are reciprocals, measured in s and Hz respectively. On a displacement-time graph, the time between adjacent crests gives period. The separation between crests on a distance graph instead gives wavelength.

132.chn: 波速描述波形或相位沿介質傳播的快慢。一個週期內波形前進一個波長，因此波速等於頻率乘波長。這與粒子在原位振動的瞬時速率不同。計算前把波長及週期轉成相配單位，並確認所有量描述的是同一種波及同一介質。
132.eng: Wave speed describes how fast the waveform or phase propagates. In one period it advances one wavelength, so speed equals frequency times wavelength. This differs from the instantaneous speed of a particle oscillating locally. Use consistent units and ensure all quantities refer to the same wave in the same medium.

133.chn: 波速描述波形或相位沿介質傳播的快慢。一個週期內波形前進一個波長，因此波速等於頻率乘波長。這與粒子在原位振動的瞬時速率不同。計算前把波長及週期轉成相配單位，並確認所有量描述的是同一種波及同一介質。
133.eng: Wave speed describes how fast the waveform or phase propagates. In one period it advances one wavelength, so speed equals frequency times wavelength. This differs from the instantaneous speed of a particle oscillating locally. Use consistent units and ensure all quantities refer to the same wave in the same medium.

134.chn: 沿張緊繩或彈簧傳播的波，張力增加時傳得較快，每單位長度的質量增加時傳得較慢。波速取決於介質及其狀態，並非單靠搖動得更快就增大。介質條件固定時，提高波源頻率會縮短波長。
134.eng: Waves on a taut string or spring travel faster with greater tension and slower with greater mass per unit length. Speed depends on the medium and its state, not simply on how rapidly the source is shaken. With unchanged medium conditions, increasing source frequency shortens wavelength.

135.chn:
在均勻、無衰減介質中的理想正弦行波，各粒子的振幅、頻率和週期相同，相位則隨位置改變。同相粒子的位移和振動方向相同；反相粒子的位移及運動方向相反，兩者在週期中相差半個週期。

位移—位置圖顯示同一時刻不同粒子的位移；位移—時間圖則追蹤同一粒子。比較相近時刻的波形，可判斷粒子的振動方向。波峰向前傳播，表示波形向前移，介質粒子仍在平衡位置附近振動。
135.eng:
In an ideal sinusoidal travelling wave in a uniform medium without attenuation, particles share amplitude, frequency and period, but their phases depend on position. In-phase particles have the same displacement and motion direction. Antiphase particles have opposite displacements and velocities and are half a cycle apart.

A displacement-position graph shows different particles at one instant. A displacement-time graph follows one particle. Comparing waveforms at nearby times reveals a particle's direction of motion. A moving crest shows the wave pattern advancing; particles still oscillate around their equilibrium positions.

136.chn: 同一介質及相同狀態下，波速保持不變，波長便與頻率成反比。頻率加倍，波長減半。波跨入另一介質時，頻率由波源決定而保持不變，此時改變的是波速及波長。
136.eng: In the same medium under unchanged conditions, wave speed stays fixed, so wavelength is inversely proportional to frequency: doubling frequency halves wavelength. On crossing into a different medium, source frequency remains unchanged while speed and wavelength change together.

137.chn: 波到達邊界後返回原介質，稱為反射。入射角等於反射角，兩者均由法線量度。在同一介質中反射，波速、頻率和波長均不變。反射後是否反相，則由邊界條件決定，例如固定端反射會反相。
137.eng: Reflection returns a wave from a boundary into its original medium. Incidence and reflection angles, measured from the normal, are equal. Since the medium is unchanged, speed, frequency and wavelength remain unchanged. This angular rule is separate from phase reversal, which depends on the boundary conditions, such as reflection at a fixed end.

138.chn: 水波由深水進入淺水時，波速下降，頻率不變，所以波長縮短。斜入射會偏向法線。由淺水進入深水則相反。折射角與波速或波長比相連，角度須由法線量度。正入射雖不轉向，波速及波長仍會改變。
138.eng: Water waves entering shallower water slow down while frequency stays constant, so wavelength decreases. Oblique rays bend towards the normal. The reverse occurs on entering deeper water. Refraction angles are related to speed or wavelength ratios and are measured from the normal. At normal incidence, speed and wavelength change even though direction does not.

139.chn: 水波由深水進入淺水時，波速下降，頻率不變，所以波長縮短。斜入射會偏向法線。由淺水進入深水則相反。折射角與波速或波長比相連，角度須由法線量度。正入射雖不轉向，波速及波長仍會改變。
139.eng: Water waves entering shallower water slow down while frequency stays constant, so wavelength decreases. Oblique rays bend towards the normal. The reverse occurs on entering deeper water. Refraction angles are related to speed or wavelength ratios and are measured from the normal. At normal incidence, speed and wavelength change even though direction does not.

140.chn: 水波由深水進入淺水時，波速下降，頻率不變，所以波長縮短。斜入射會偏向法線。由淺水進入深水則相反。折射角與波速或波長比相連，角度須由法線量度。正入射雖不轉向，波速及波長仍會改變。
140.eng: Water waves entering shallower water slow down while frequency stays constant, so wavelength decreases. Oblique rays bend towards the normal. The reverse occurs on entering deeper water. Refraction angles are related to speed or wavelength ratios and are measured from the normal. At normal incidence, speed and wavelength change even though direction does not.

141.chn: 波經過狹縫或障礙物邊緣時會擴散進入幾何陰影區，稱為衍射。相同縫寬下波長越長，或相同波長下縫越窄，擴散越明顯。波長與縫寬相近時最容易看出。衍射在同一介質內發生，不要求波速改變。
141.eng: Diffraction is the spreading of waves through a gap or around an obstacle into the geometrical shadow. Spreading becomes more pronounced with a longer wavelength at fixed gap width, or a narrower gap at fixed wavelength. It is readily visible when wavelength and gap width are comparable. Diffraction within one medium does not require a speed change.

142.chn: 波經過狹縫或障礙物邊緣時會擴散進入幾何陰影區，稱為衍射。相同縫寬下波長越長，或相同波長下縫越窄，擴散越明顯。波長與縫寬相近時最容易看出。衍射在同一介質內發生，不要求波速改變。
142.eng: Diffraction is the spreading of waves through a gap or around an obstacle into the geometrical shadow. Spreading becomes more pronounced with a longer wavelength at fixed gap width, or a narrower gap at fixed wavelength. It is readily visible when wavelength and gap width are comparable. Diffraction within one medium does not require a speed change.

143.chn: 兩列或更多波在同一位置重疊時，合位移是各波在該點的位移之和，必須按方向帶正負號相加。疊加的是位移而不是直接相加能量。兩脈衝相遇後，在理想線性介質中會繼續沿原方向傳播，暫時抵消不表示波被永久消滅。
143.eng: When waves overlap, their resultant displacement at each point is the signed sum of individual displacements. Add displacements, not energies directly. After meeting, pulses in an ideal linear medium continue in their original directions. Temporary cancellation does not mean the waves have been permanently destroyed.

144.chn: 頻率相同、相位差固定的波，可形成穩定的干涉圖形。若兩波源同相，程差為整數個波長時相長，為半整數個波長時相消。完全抵消還須兩波振幅相等。若兩波源反相，相長和相消的程差條件便互換。
144.eng: Waves of equal frequency and stable phase difference produce a stable interference pattern. For in-phase sources, integer-wavelength path differences give constructive interference and half-integer differences give destructive interference. Complete cancellation also requires equal amplitudes. Initially antiphase sources interchange these conditions, so source phase must be considered as well as path difference.

145.chn: 頻率相同、相位差固定的波，可形成穩定的干涉圖形。若兩波源同相，程差為整數個波長時相長，為半整數個波長時相消。完全抵消還須兩波振幅相等。若兩波源反相，相長和相消的程差條件便互換。
145.eng: Waves of equal frequency and stable phase difference produce a stable interference pattern. For in-phase sources, integer-wavelength path differences give constructive interference and half-integer differences give destructive interference. Complete cancellation also requires equal amplitudes. Initially antiphase sources interchange these conditions, so source phase must be considered as well as path difference.

146.chn: 對同相相干水波源，在同一觀察區域，波長增大或波源間距減小，都會使相鄰節線和腹線分得更開。這時，觀察方向須改變更大的角度，程差才會達到下一個干涉條件。比較條紋時，其他條件須保持不變。
146.eng: For coherent, in-phase water-wave sources in the same observation region, a longer wavelength or smaller source separation spreads neighbouring nodal and antinodal lines farther apart. The observation direction must then change through a larger angle to reach the next interference condition. Keep other conditions fixed when comparing patterns.

147.chn: 反射、折射、衍射和干涉都是波可展示的現象。其中衍射與干涉尤其能顯示波的疊加及擴散特性。單看反射或路徑偏折不足以確立波模型。
147.eng: Reflection, refraction, diffraction and interference can all occur with waves. Diffraction and interference are particularly characteristic of wave spreading and superposition. Reflection or a deflected path alone does not establish a wave model.

148.chn:
兩列頻率、振幅和速率相同的反向行波疊加，可形成位置固定的波節和波腹。波節的振幅為零，波腹最大。相鄰波節相距半個波長，波節與最近波腹相距四分之一波長。

所有非波節位置的粒子以相同頻率振動，但振幅因位置而異。相鄰兩個波節之間的粒子同相，會同時向同一方向運動；隔着一個波節的相鄰波段則反相，一段向上時另一段向下。波節始終不振動。
148.eng:
Oppositely travelling waves with equal frequency, amplitude and speed can form fixed nodes and antinodes. Nodes have zero amplitude and antinodes maximum amplitude. Adjacent nodes are half a wavelength apart; a node and its nearest antinode are a quarter wavelength apart.

All particles away from nodes oscillate at the same frequency, but amplitude varies with position. Particles between two adjacent nodes are in phase and move in the same direction together. Neighbouring loops separated by a node are in antiphase: one moves upwards as the other moves downwards. Nodes remain at rest.

149.chn: 兩條狹縫作為相干光源，在遠處屏幕上形成明暗相間的條紋。小角度下，相鄰亮紋或相鄰暗紋的間距，與波長和屏幕距離成正比，與兩縫間距成反比。兩縫間距是縫中心之間的距離。亮紋到最近暗紋的距離，是條紋間距的一半。
149.eng: Two coherent slits produce alternating bright and dark fringes on a distant screen. At small angles, spacing between adjacent fringes of the same type is proportional to wavelength and screen distance and inversely proportional to slit separation. Slit separation is not slit width, and bright-to-nearest-dark spacing is only half the fringe spacing.

150.chn: 兩條狹縫作為相干光源，在遠處屏幕上形成明暗相間的條紋。小角度下，相鄰亮紋或相鄰暗紋的間距，與波長和屏幕距離成正比，與兩縫間距成反比。兩縫間距是縫中心之間的距離。亮紋到最近暗紋的距離，是條紋間距的一半。
150.eng: Two coherent slits produce alternating bright and dark fringes on a distant screen. At small angles, spacing between adjacent fringes of the same type is proportional to wavelength and screen distance and inversely proportional to slit separation. Slit separation is not slit width, and bright-to-nearest-dark spacing is only half the fringe spacing.

151.chn: 光垂直入射等間距光柵時，相鄰縫射向同一方向的光若程差為整數個波長，便形成該級亮紋。對固定級次，波長越長或柵線間距越小，衍射角越大。屏幕移遠只改變亮紋位置，不改變角度。柵線密度要先取倒數求縫距。
151.eng: For normal incidence on equally spaced slits, a bright order forms when rays from adjacent slits have an integer-wavelength path difference. At a fixed order, longer wavelength or smaller slit separation increases the diffraction angle. Moving the screen changes positions but not angles. Convert line density to slit separation by taking its reciprocal with consistent units.

152.chn: 光垂直入射等間距光柵時，相鄰縫射向同一方向的光若程差為整數個波長，便形成該級亮紋。對固定級次，波長越長或柵線間距越小，衍射角越大。屏幕移遠只改變亮紋位置，不改變角度。柵線密度要先取倒數求縫距。
152.eng: For normal incidence on equally spaced slits, a bright order forms when rays from adjacent slits have an integer-wavelength path difference. At a fixed order, longer wavelength or smaller slit separation increases the diffraction angle. Moving the screen changes positions but not angles. Convert line density to slit separation by taking its reciprocal with consistent units.

153.chn: 光柵方程中的正弦值最多為 1，據此可求出允許的最大整數級次。如果某級次恰好對應 90°，光會沿光柵平面前進，不能到達前方屏幕。計算屏幕上可見的級次時須排除。求總亮紋數時，通常包括中央零級及兩側的對稱級次。
153.eng: The grating equation and the condition that sine cannot exceed 1 determine the greatest allowed integer order. An order exactly at 90° travels along the grating plane and does not reach a screen in front, so exclude it when counting observable orders there. Total bright orders usually include the central zero order and symmetric orders on both sides.

154.chn: 聲音需要介質傳播。聲速取決於介質的彈性、密度和温度等條件。常見材料中，聲速通常在固體較大，液體次之，氣體較小，但仍有例外。在同一介質、相同狀態下，增大響度或改變波源頻率，一般不會直接改變聲速。
154.eng: Sound requires a medium. Its speed depends on properties including elasticity, density and temperature. Common materials often transmit sound faster in solids than liquids and faster in liquids than gases, but this is not universal. With medium conditions fixed, increasing loudness or changing source frequency does not normally change sound speed directly.

155.chn: 聲波與其他波一樣會反射、折射、衍射和干涉：回聲來自反射，聲速不同的區域可使聲音轉向，聲音能繞過障礙物則涉及衍射。多個相干聲源可造成強弱相間位置。
155.eng: Sound reflects, refracts, diffracts and interferes like other waves. Echoes result from reflection. Regions of different sound speed can bend propagation. Spreading around obstacles involves diffraction. Coherent sources can produce alternating loud and quiet positions.

156.chn: 年輕且聽力正常者的可聽頻率大約為 20 Hz 至 20 kHz，較低稱為次聲，較高稱為超聲。實際聽覺範圍因人及年齡而異。這是按頻率分類，並非按響度分類。超聲也不是電磁波，在真空中不能傳播。
156.eng: A young person with normal hearing typically hears about 20 Hz to 20 kHz. Lower frequencies are infrasound and higher frequencies are ultrasound. Actual limits vary with age and individual hearing. This classification concerns frequency, not loudness. Ultrasound is a mechanical wave, not electromagnetic radiation, and cannot travel through a vacuum.

Actual limits vary with age and individual hearing. This classification concerns frequency, not loudness. Ultrasound is a mechanical wave, not electromagnetic radiation, and cannot travel through a vacuum.

158.chn: 音調主要隨頻率提高而升高。在可比較頻率和條件下，振幅越大通常聽起來越響。音品取決於波形及諧波成分，所以相同音調和響度的樂器仍可分辨。
158.eng: Pitch generally rises with frequency. At comparable frequency and conditions, greater amplitude usually sounds louder. Quality or timbre depends on waveform and harmonic content, allowing instruments with the same pitch and loudness to sound different.

159.chn: 同性電荷互斥，異性電荷互吸，兩物體彼此受力大小相同。帶電體也可透過電荷重新分佈，吸引中性物體，所以吸引現象有不止一種可能。若兩物體互相排斥，便可直接判斷兩者帶同號電荷。
159.eng: Like charges repel and unlike charges attract, with equal force magnitudes on the two objects. Attraction alone does not prove opposite net charges, since charge redistribution can make a charged object attract a neutral one. Repulsion provides direct evidence that both objects carry charges of the same sign.

160.chn: 孤立系統的淨電荷保持不變。充電是電荷轉移或分離的過程。摩擦可使兩物體帶上等量異號電荷。兩導體接觸後，總電荷仍守恆。電荷如何分配則取決於導體的形狀和大小，各自的電荷量可以改變。
160.eng: Net charge remains constant in an isolated system. Charging transfers or separates charge rather than creating it. Rubbing can leave two objects with equal and opposite charges. When conductors touch, total charge is conserved, not each conductor's original charge. The final division need not be equal and depends on their geometry and size.

161.chn:
帶電物體靠近中性物體時，會使絕緣體內的正負電荷稍為分離，或使導體內的自由電子重新分布。較近的異號電荷所受吸引較強，物體可被吸引而仍保持整體中性。

感應充電利用接地改變導體的淨電荷。以正棒靠近中性金屬球為例：先保持棒的位置並接地，電子由大地流入球；先斷開接地，使多出的電子留在球上，再移走棒，球便帶負電。若使用負棒，電子會流向大地，完成相同步驟後球帶正電。
161.eng:
A nearby charge slightly separates positive and negative charge in an insulator or redistributes free electrons in a conductor. The nearer opposite charge experiences stronger attraction, so the object can be attracted while remaining neutral overall.

Charging by induction uses earthing to change a conductor's net charge. Hold a positive rod near a neutral metal sphere and earth the sphere: electrons flow from Earth into it. Disconnect the earth first to retain the extra electrons, then remove the rod. The sphere is left negatively charged. With a negative rod, electrons flow to Earth and the same sequence leaves the sphere positively charged.

162.chn: 真空或近似空氣中的兩點電荷，作用力大小與電荷量乘積成正比、與距離平方成反比，方向沿兩電荷連線。先用電荷量大小求力，再按同號相斥、異號相吸決定方向。有多個電荷時，要把各個力以矢量相加。
162.eng: For point charges in vacuum, or approximately in air, force magnitude is proportional to the product of charge magnitudes and inversely proportional to separation squared. It acts along their joining line. Calculate the magnitude first, then determine attraction or repulsion from the signs. With multiple charges, add the individual forces as vectors.

163.chn: 電場表示每單位正測試電荷所受的電力，方向約定為正電荷受力方向。放入負電荷時，受力方向與電場相反。測試電荷須足夠小，避免明顯改變原有電荷分佈。電場由場源決定，不因用較大測試電荷量度就變強。
163.eng: Electric field is electric force per unit positive test charge. Its direction is the force direction on a positive charge. A negative charge feels the opposite force. A test charge must be small enough not to appreciably disturb the source distribution. Using a larger test charge does not itself make the original field stronger.

164.chn:
點電荷的電場大小與場源電荷量成正比、與距離平方成反比。正電荷的場向外，負電荷的場向內。多個場源同時存在時，須逐一求該點的電場矢量再合成。某點電場為零，不表示附近沒有電荷或每個場都為零。

＊延伸題：取無限遠處電勢為零，孤立點電荷的電勢 \(V=\frac{Q}{4\pi\varepsilon_0r}\)，與距離成反比；同一電荷有 \(V_Y/V_X=r_X/r_Y\)。這是 2014 卷一甲第 23 題標有＊的應用。
164.eng:
A point charge's electric field magnitude is proportional to source charge magnitude and inversely proportional to distance squared. It points outwards from positive charge and inwards towards negative charge. Add fields from multiple sources as vectors at the specified point. A zero resultant field does not imply absent charges or zero individual fields.

* Extension question: with potential zero at infinity, an isolated point charge has \(V=\frac{Q}{4\pi\varepsilon_0r}\), inversely proportional to distance. For the same charge, \(V_Y/V_X=r_X/r_Y\). This is the asterisked application in 2014 Paper 1A Q23.

165.chn: 大平行板之間遠離邊緣處的電場近似均勻，大小等於板間電勢差除以板距，方向由高電勢指向低電勢。固定電壓下縮小板距會增強電場。粒子受力還須乘其電荷，負電荷受力與場方向相反。
165.eng: Between large parallel plates, away from edges, the field is approximately uniform. Its magnitude is potential difference divided by plate separation and its direction is from higher to lower potential. At fixed voltage, reducing separation strengthens the field. Multiply field by particle charge to find force. Negative charges are forced opposite the field direction.

168.chn: 電流是每單位時間通過截面的電荷量，1 A 表示每秒通過 1 C。傳統電流按正電荷移動方向定義，在外電路由電源正極流向負極。金屬中實際移動的電子方向相反。流過元件時能量可被轉換，但電荷不會被「用光」。
168.eng: Current is charge passing a cross-section per unit time; 1 A is 1 C per second. Conventional current follows positive-charge motion, from the positive to negative terminal through the external circuit. Electrons in metals move oppositely. Components convert electrical energy, but do not use up the charge flowing through them.

169.chn: 電流是每單位時間通過截面的電荷量，1 A 表示每秒通過 1 C。傳統電流按正電荷移動方向定義，在外電路由電源正極流向負極。金屬中實際移動的電子方向相反。流過元件時能量可被轉換，但電荷不會被「用光」。

171.chn: 穩定電路中沒有電荷持續積聚，所以同一串聯支路各處電流相同，而流入節點的總電流等於流出總電流。分支電流不一定平均分配，須由各支路電阻和電壓決定。不能把流經電阻後的電流説成因耗能而減少。
171.eng: In a steady circuit, charge does not continually accumulate. Current is therefore the same everywhere along one series branch, and total current entering a junction equals total current leaving it. Branch currents need not be equal. They depend on branch resistances and voltages. Energy dissipation in a resistor does not consume current.

172.chn: 電源的電動勢表示它每輸送一單位電荷所提供的能量，以伏特表示，並不是一種力。實際電源有內阻時，部分能量在內部轉為熱，因此向外供電的端電壓可小於電動勢。無電流時端電壓才近似等於電動勢。
172.eng: A source's electromotive force, or e.m.f., is energy supplied per unit charge and is measured in volts. It is not a force. Internal resistance dissipates some energy when a real source supplies current, so terminal voltage can be lower than e.m.f. With no current, terminal voltage is approximately equal to e.m.f.

173.chn: 兩點間的電勢差表示每單位電荷在兩點之間轉移時所對應的能量改變。在負載中可用轉換的電能除以通過電荷量求大小。1 V 相當於每庫侖 1 J。電壓是兩點之間的比較，並非流過元件的物理量。
173.eng: Potential difference relates energy change to the charge transferred between two points. For a load, its magnitude can be found by dividing electrical energy converted by charge passing through. One volt is one joule per coulomb. Voltage is a comparison between points, not something that flows through a component.

174.chn: 兩點間的電勢差表示每單位電荷在兩點之間轉移時所對應的能量改變。在負載中可用轉換的電能除以通過電荷量求大小。1 V 相當於每庫侖 1 J。電壓是兩點之間的比較，並非流過元件的物理量。
174.eng: Potential difference relates energy change to the charge transferred between two points. For a load, its magnitude can be found by dividing electrical energy converted by charge passing through. One volt is one joule per coulomb. Voltage is a comparison between points, not something that flows through a component.

175.chn: 串聯負載分配電源的端電壓，各段電勢差相加等於總端電壓。每段分得多少電壓，取決於電阻。連接同一對節點的並聯支路，電勢差則相同。如果電源有內阻，外電路的端電壓須與電動勢分別處理。
175.eng: Series loads share the applied terminal voltage, with individual voltage drops adding to the total. Parallel branches connected to the same two nodes have equal potential differences. Series voltage division is not necessarily equal and depends on resistance. With source internal resistance, the external terminal voltage must not automatically be equated to e.m.f.

176.chn: 電池串聯時，電動勢按極性相加：同向相加，反向相減。相同電池以相同極性並聯，總電動勢與單一電池相同，而等效內阻較小。若電池的電動勢不同，可能產生電池間的環流，須另作分析。
176.eng: Series-cell e.m.f.s add according to polarity: aligned cells add and opposing cells subtract. Identical cells connected in parallel with matching polarity have the same total e.m.f. as one cell, but a smaller equivalent internal resistance. Cells with unequal e.m.f.s can produce circulating currents and must be analysed separately.

177.chn:
電阻是某個工作點的電壓與電流之比，即 \(R=V/I\)。温度及其他物理條件固定時，遵守歐姆定律的元件有 \(V\propto I\)，電阻保持不變。燈絲受熱後電阻增大，所以圖線可能彎曲。

若 V 在縱軸、I 在橫軸，通過原點的直線斜率就是電阻。若圖線彎曲，先讀出所需工作點的 V 和 I，再求 V/I；這等於原點連至該點的直線斜率。交換兩軸後，直線斜率為電阻的倒數。
177.eng:
Resistance at an operating point is the voltage-to-current ratio, \(R=V/I\). An ohmic component has \(V\propto I\) and constant resistance when temperature and other physical conditions remain fixed. A filament's resistance rises as it heats, so its graph can curve.

With V on the vertical axis and I on the horizontal axis, the slope of a straight line through the origin equals resistance. For a curved graph, read V and I at the required point and calculate V/I. This is the slope of the line joining the origin to that point. Reversing the axes makes the straight-line slope the reciprocal of resistance.

電阻是某個工作點的電壓與電流之比，即 \(R=V/I\)。温度及其他物理條件固定時，遵守歐姆定律的元件有 \(V\propto I\)，電阻保持不變。燈絲受熱後電阻增大，所以圖線可能彎曲。

179.chn: 均勻導線的電阻與長度及電阻率成正比，與橫截面積成反比。導線越長越難通電，越粗通常越容易通電。電阻率取決於材料及温度，計算面積時半徑或直徑要先換成正確單位。拉長導線若體積不變，截面積也會一起改變。
179.eng: For a uniform wire, resistance is proportional to length and resistivity and inversely proportional to cross-sectional area. Longer wires resist more. Thicker ones resist less under comparable conditions. Resistivity depends on material and temperature. Convert radius or diameter correctly before calculating area. Stretching at constant volume changes both length and area.

180.chn: 均勻導線的電阻與長度及電阻率成正比，與橫截面積成反比。導線越長越難通電，越粗通常越容易通電。電阻率取決於材料及温度，計算面積時半徑或直徑要先換成正確單位。拉長導線若體積不變，截面積也會一起改變。
