The reflection coefficient is an intensity ratio, not an amplitude ratio, and lies between zero and one. Coupling gel reduces strong reflection from an air gap between probe and skin.

350.chn: 超聲脈衝發出後要走到反射面再返回探頭，所以用回波時間求深度時須把聲速乘時間再除以二。兩回波的時間差可求同一路徑上兩界面的間距。若經過多種介質，應分段使用聲速，不能把整段都當成同一材料。
350.eng: An ultrasound pulse travels to an interface and back, so depth equals speed times round-trip time divided by two. The time difference between echoes can give separation of interfaces on the same path. For different materials along the path, calculate each travel time using the appropriate sound speed.

351.chn: 在相同組織中，較高頻率的超聲通常衰減較快，能有效探測的深度較小。降低頻率可探得較深，但通常犧牲細節分辨能力。選頻率時要兼顧目標深度和解析需求。
351.eng: Within the same tissue, higher-frequency ultrasound generally attenuates faster and has less penetration depth. Lower frequency reaches deeper but usually sacrifices detail resolution. Balance target depth against resolving requirements when choosing frequency.

352.chn: 兩個沿聲束方向相近的界面，只有回波在時間上分得足夠開，才可辨認。脈衝越短，軸向分辨能力越好。最小可分辨間距約為空間脈衝長度的一半。如果每脈衝包含的週期數固定，提高頻率才可直接縮短脈衝。
352.eng: Nearby interfaces along the beam are distinguishable only if their echoes are sufficiently separated in time. Shorter pulses improve axial resolution. The limiting separation is about half the spatial pulse length. Higher frequency directly shortens a pulse only when its number of cycles is held fixed.

353.chn: 單能窄射束通過均勻材料時，強度隨厚度指數下降，半值厚度是使強度減半的厚度。每增加一個半值厚度，就在剩餘強度上再減半。衰減係數越大，半值厚度越小。公式中係數與厚度單位須互相抵消，且不表示到某厚度後射線突然全無。
353.eng: A monoenergetic narrow beam in uniform material decreases exponentially in intensity. Half-value thickness halves intensity. Each additional such thickness halves what remains. A larger attenuation coefficient means smaller half-value thickness. Coefficient and thickness units must cancel. The model does not predict a sudden complete stop at finite thickness.

354.chn: 單能窄射束通過均勻材料時，強度隨厚度指數下降，半值厚度是使強度減半的厚度。每增加一個半值厚度，就在剩餘強度上再減半。衰減係數越大，半值厚度越小。公式中係數與厚度單位須互相抵消，且不表示到某厚度後射線突然全無。
354.eng: A monoenergetic narrow beam in uniform material decreases exponentially in intensity. Half-value thickness halves intensity. Each additional such thickness halves what remains. A larger attenuation coefficient means smaller half-value thickness. Coefficient and thickness units must cancel. The model does not predict a sudden complete stop at finite thickness.

355.chn: X 射線衰減取決於物質組成、密度及光子能量。組成與能量相近時，密度較大通常衰減較強。在常見診斷能區且遠離吸收邊緣時，光子能量較高通常較易穿透。這些是有條件的趨勢，不能當作跨所有材料與能量都必然成立。
355.eng: Attenuation depends on composition, density and photon energy. With similar composition and energy, greater density generally means stronger attenuation. In common diagnostic-energy ranges away from absorption edges, higher-energy photons usually penetrate more readily. These are conditional trends, not universal rules across all materials and energies.

356.chn: X 射線衰減取決於物質組成、密度及光子能量。組成與能量相近時，密度較大通常衰減較強。在常見診斷能區且遠離吸收邊緣時，光子能量較高通常較易穿透。這些是有條件的趨勢，不能當作跨所有材料與能量都必然成立。
356.eng: Attenuation depends on composition, density and photon energy. With similar composition and energy, greater density generally means stronger attenuation. In common diagnostic-energy ranges away from absorption edges, higher-energy photons usually penetrate more readily. These are conditional trends, not universal rules across all materials and energies.

357.chn: 射線逐層通過材料時，上一層透出的強度，就是下一層的入射強度。總透射比例是各層透射比例的乘積。寫成指數形式時，則把各層「衰減係數乘厚度」的結果相加。每層厚度均沿射線實際路徑量度。
357.eng: Each layer's transmitted intensity becomes the next layer's incident intensity. Multiply transmission fractions, or add each coefficient-times-thickness term in the exponent. Do not add attenuation percentages directly. Measure each thickness along the actual beam path.

358.chn: 不同組織使 X 射線衰減程度不同，探測到的透射強度差形成對比。課本慣用顯示中，高衰減的骨等部位較淺，較低衰減處較深。數碼顯示可反相，所以應先確認色階。影像明暗取決於沿路徑的總衰減，不能只看單一組織密度。
358.eng: Tissues attenuate X-rays differently, creating contrast in detected transmission. In the conventional textbook display, strongly attenuating structures such as bone appear light and less attenuating regions dark. Digital displays can be inverted, so check the scale. Appearance depends on total path attenuation, not one tissue's density alone.

359.chn: 當某器官與周圍組織對 X 射線的衰減太相近，影像不易區分。適當顯影劑能改變指定部位的衰減，使透射強度差增加而提高對比。這是改善組織間的可辨程度，不等同增加像素數或改變儀器的空間分辨極限。
359.eng: An organ is difficult to distinguish when its attenuation resembles surrounding tissue. An appropriate contrast agent changes attenuation in the chosen region, increasing transmitted-intensity differences and contrast. This improves tissue differentiation, not pixel count or the instrument's intrinsic spatial resolution.

360.chn: CT 從多個角度量度穿過身體切面的 X 射線衰減投影，再由電腦重建切面各位置的衰減係數分佈。多個角度的資訊有助分開在普通投影影像中重疊的組織。
360.eng: Computed tomography measures attenuation projections through a section from many directions and reconstructs the distribution of attenuation coefficients computationally. Multiple views separate tissues that overlap in an ordinary projection.

361.chn:
放射性示蹤劑會按生理過程分布到身體或指定器官。探測器量出由體內發出的 γ 射線，重建示蹤劑分布，從而了解器官功能。一般 X 射線攝影則使用體外射線，量度穿過身體後的透射量。

示蹤劑應能到達或被目標部位吸收，並發出可穿出身體而被探測的輻射。半衰期要足夠完成檢查，又應盡量減少檢查後的照射時間；活度和用量也要兼顧影像訊號與輻射劑量。
361.eng:
A radioactive tracer distributes according to physiological processes within the body or target organ. Detectors measure gamma rays emitted from inside to reconstruct tracer distribution and reveal function. Ordinary X-ray imaging instead uses an external source and measures transmission through the body.

A tracer should reach or be taken up by the target region and emit radiation that can escape the body for detection. Its half-life should allow the examination while limiting irradiation afterwards. Activity and amount must provide a useful signal with an appropriate radiation dose.

362.chn: 物理半衰期描述單靠核衰變，使某核素的未衰變核數減半所需的時間，是核素的特徵。它不計物質被身體排出的效果。示蹤物在體內的活度可能下降得更快，因為衰變與生物排除同時發生。
362.eng: Physical half-life is the time for a nuclide's undecayed population to halve through nuclear decay alone. It is a property of the nuclide and excludes biological removal. Tracer activity in the body can decrease faster because decay and biological clearance operate together.

363.chn: 生物半衰期描述指定物質因代謝、排泄等生物過程，從身體或目標部位減至一半所需時間，不涉及核本身是否衰變。它取決於物質及生理過程。把它與物理半衰期合併時，須確認兩種下降可近似為獨立的指數過程。
363.eng: Biological half-life is the time for metabolism, excretion or other biological processes to remove half a substance from the body or target region, independently of nuclear decay. It depends on the substance and physiology. Combining it with physical half-life requires approximately independent exponential decreases.

364.chn:
體內示蹤劑會因核衰變和生物清除而減少。物理半衰期 t_p 描述核衰變，生物半衰期 t_b 描述代謝、排泄等清除過程；有效半衰期 t_e 則描述兩者同時作用的結果。

若兩種過程各自按指數規律、近似獨立地進行，減少速率可相加，得到下方的倒數和公式。兩種作用同時令示蹤劑減少，所以有效半衰期比任何一個有限的單獨半衰期更短。計算時三者使用相同時間單位。
364.eng:
A tracer decreases in the body through both radioactive decay and biological removal. Physical half-life t_p describes decay; biological half-life t_b describes removal by metabolism, excretion and related processes. Effective half-life t_e describes their combined result.

If both decreases are approximately independent and exponential, their removal rates add, giving the reciprocal-sum relation below. Acting together makes the effective half-life shorter than either finite half-life alone. Use the same time units throughout.

365.chn: 熱點表示某部位示蹤物攝入或積聚較多，冷點表示較少，須依所用示蹤物及正常分佈解讀。課本灰階以熱點較深、冷點較淺呈現，但其他色階可不同。名稱不表示實際温度高低，也不能單憑熱點便下同一種診斷。
365.eng: Hot spots show relatively high tracer uptake and cold spots relatively low uptake. Interpretation depends on the tracer and normal distribution. Textbook greyscale makes hot spots darker and cold spots lighter, but other scales differ. The names do not indicate temperature, nor does every hot spot imply the same diagnosis.

366.chn: 先確認「向右位移為正」。在位移—距離圖上，曲線由正變負穿過橫軸的位置是密部中心。由負變正則是疏部中心。圖的高低表示位移，不是粒子實際上下移動。用課本相鄰粒子圖可看出：兩旁粒子朝中心擠近形成密部，向外分開形成疏部。
366.eng: First establish that displacement to the right is positive. On a displacement-distance graph, a downward crossing of zero marks a compression centre. An upward crossing marks a rarefaction centre. Graph height represents displacement, not vertical particle motion. The neighbouring-particle diagram shows particles crowding towards a compression or separating away from a rarefaction.

367.chn: 簡諧振動的粒子經過平衡位置時，速率最大。到最大位移處時，則瞬間靜止，然後反向運動。由 \(K=\frac12mu^2\) 可知，平衡位置的動能最大，最大位移處的動能為零。粒子的振動速率隨時間改變，波速則描述波形在介質中傳播的快慢。
367.eng: For simple harmonic particle motion in a wave, speed is greatest at equilibrium and momentarily zero at maximum displacement before reversal. Since \(K=\frac12mu^2\), kinetic energy is greatest in the first case and zero in the second. Zero displacement therefore does not mean rest. Particle speed varies during oscillation and differs from the waveform's propagation speed.

368.chn: 脈衝在固定端反射時會反相：波峰變波谷，波谷變波峰，傳播方向也反轉。同一介質中的波速不變。對週期波，頻率和波長也不變。畫反射脈衝時，須同時反轉上下的正負位移和左右的輪廓，因為先到端點的部分也先離開。
368.eng: A pulse reflected at a fixed end is inverted: crests become troughs and propagation reverses. In the same medium, wave speed stays unchanged, as do frequency and wavelength for periodic waves. When drawing the reflected pulse, reverse both its sign and its left-right profile: the part reaching the end first also leaves first, so a vertical flip alone is insufficient.

369.chn: 凹透鏡使光線發散。平行主軸的入射光，折射後的反向延長線通過入射側焦點；朝另一側焦點入射的光，折射後平行主軸；通過光心的光，在薄透鏡模型中近似直行。從同一物點畫出兩條光線，其反向延長線相交的位置就是虛像位置。
369.eng: A concave lens diverges light. A ray parallel to the principal axis emerges as if from the near focus. A ray directed towards the far focus emerges parallel to the axis. A ray through the optical centre is approximately undeviated in the thin-lens model. Draw two rays from one object point and extend them backwards; their intersection locates the virtual image.

371.chn: 電磁波按波長由長到短排列為：無線電波、微波、紅外線、可見光、紫外線、X 射線、γ 射線。頻率沿這個次序增加，因為真空中的波速均為 \(c=3.0\times10^8\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\)，並滿足 \(c=f\lambda\)。常見用途有：無線電波用於廣播。微波用於加熱、雷達和衛星通訊。紅外線用於熱成像。紫外線用於殺菌。X 射線用於透視。比較波長時須讀圖上刻度，各波段的界線並非完全分明。
371.eng: From longest to shortest wavelength, the spectrum runs through radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays. Frequency increases along this sequence because all travel in vacuum at \(c=3.0\times10^8\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\), with \(c=f\lambda\). Typical uses include broadcasting, microwave heating and satellite communication, infrared imaging, ultraviolet sterilisation and X-ray imaging. Read the wavelength scale carefully. Neighbouring bands have no perfectly sharp boundaries.

372.chn: 微波能穿過大氣，可用於衛星通訊。大氣則阻擋大部分太陽紫外線。這說明不同波段的吸收不同。若題目給出大氣吸收圖，應再按指定波長讀值，不把整個波段一律當作可穿透。
372.eng: Suitable microwave bands pass through the atmosphere and support satellite communication, whereas the atmosphere blocks much solar ultraviolet. Absorption therefore depends on wavelength. If an atmospheric-transmission graph is supplied, read it at the specified wavelength rather than assuming every wavelength within a named band transmits equally well.

373.chn: 電場線由正電荷出發，終止於負電荷。箭頭表示電場方向。場線越密，電場越強。場線不會互相交叉。
373.eng: Electric field lines start from positive charges and end at negative charges. Their arrows show the field direction. Closer spacing indicates a stronger field, and field lines never intersect.

376.chn: 超聲波可發出後接收回波，用來探測魚群、掃描和找材料裂縫。課本另列清洗精細物件及集中能量破碎腎石。
376.eng: Transmitted ultrasound and returning echoes locate fish, scan structures and reveal cracks in materials. Other textbook applications include cleaning delicate objects and concentrating energy to break kidney stones.

377.chn:
α、β⁻ 和 γ 的性質如下。α 和 β⁻ 在電場中向相反方向偏轉；若運動方向不平行於磁場，也會受磁力。γ 不帶電，在這兩種場中均不偏轉。

蓋革計數器可探測這些輻射，但 α 須能穿過薄窗，到達探測區。雲室可顯示 α 和 β 的徑跡；γ 本身不留下帶電粒子徑跡。

實驗時，縮短接觸放射源的時間、用長夾增加距離，並使用適當屏蔽。放射源用後放回屏蔽容器。量度時先記錄背景計數，再從總計數率扣除背景，求放射源的淨計數率。
377.eng:
Alpha, beta-minus and gamma properties are compared below. Alpha and beta bend in opposite directions in electric fields and experience magnetic force when motion is not parallel to the field. Uncharged gamma is undeflected in either field.

Geiger counters can detect these radiations, but alpha must pass through a thin window into the sensitive region. Cloud chambers show alpha and beta tracks; gamma itself leaves no charged-particle track.

In experiments, reduce handling time, increase distance using long tongs and use suitable shielding. Return sources to shielded storage after use. Measure background count rate and subtract it from total count rate to obtain the source's net count rate.

378.chn: 放射性衰變具有隨機性，因此計數率會上下波動，同樣條件下的兩次讀數不必完全相同。扣除背景計數可去除背景的貢獻，但不會消除計數的隨機波動。
378.eng: Radioactive counts fluctuate because decay is random. Measurements made under identical conditions need not be exactly equal. Subtracting background corrects its contribution but does not remove the intrinsic random fluctuations of the counts.

379.chn: 半衰期是大量同種不穩定原子核的數目減至一半所需的時間，也是活度降至一半所需的時間。同一核素的半衰期是固定特徵，在本課程採用的模型中不受溫度、壓力或化學狀態等外在條件影響。經過 n 個半衰期，剩餘原子核數及活度都是最初的 \((\tfrac12)^n\)。
379.eng: Half-life is the time for a large population of identical unstable nuclei, or its activity, to halve. It is characteristic of the nuclide and, in the course model, unaffected by temperature, pressure or chemical state. After n half-lives, the remaining fraction of nuclei and activity is \((\tfrac12)^n\).

381.chn: 活度 A 是放射性樣本每秒的平均衰變次數，單位是貝克（Bq），1 Bq 表示每秒一次衰變。若 N 是尚未衰變的核數，λ 是衰變常數，則 \(A=\lambda N\)。每分鐘的衰變次數除以 60，可換成 Bq。探測器通常只收到部分輻射，讀數又包含背景計數，因此計數率須與樣本總活度分別處理。
381.eng: Activity A is the mean number of nuclear decays per second, measured in becquerels: 1 Bq is one decay per second. For N undecayed nuclei with decay constant λ, \(A=\lambda N\). Divide decays per minute by 60 to convert to Bq. A detector usually records only part of the emitted radiation and includes background, so its count rate is not directly the total activity.

383.chn:
地球由西向東自轉，使天體看似每日由東向西移過天空。可把遙遠天體想像為位於以觀察者為中心的天球上；地軸延長線指向天極，天體的周日視運動繞天極進行。

觀察者的地平面與地軸夾角隨緯度改變，所以同一天體的升落路徑會因觀察位置而異。在北半球，北天極高於地平線的角度等於觀察者緯度。北極附近的天體路徑接近與地平線平行；赤道附近的升落路徑較接近垂直。

舊題應用：太陽在正午通過觀察者的子午線時，高度角可由 \(h=90^\circ-|\varphi-\delta|\) 求得；φ 是觀察緯度，δ 是當天太陽赤緯。春分、秋分時 δ 約為 0°；夏至、冬至約為 +23.5°、−23.5°。
383.eng:
Earth rotates from west to east, making celestial objects appear to move east to west each day. Imagine distant objects on a celestial sphere centred on the observer. Earth's extended axis points towards the celestial poles, about which daily apparent motion occurs.

The angle between the local horizon and Earth's axis changes with latitude, so the same object's rising and setting path depends on the observer's location. In the northern hemisphere, the north celestial pole's altitude equals the observer's latitude. Near the North Pole, paths run nearly parallel to the horizon; near the equator, rising and setting paths are closer to perpendicular.

Past-paper application: at the Sun's upper meridian passage, its altitude is \(h=90^\circ-|\varphi-\delta|\). Here φ is latitude and δ is solar declination: approximately 0° at the equinoxes, +23.5° at the June solstice and −23.5° at the December solstice.

384.chn: 恒星和行星系统属于星系的一部分。星系可组成星系群、星系团和超星系团。星团是恒星的集合，星云主要由气体和尘埃组成，两者通常位于星系内。比较尺度时须统一单位。不同类型天体的大小范围可能重叠。
384.eng: Stars and planetary systems lie within galaxies. Galaxies form groups, clusters and superclusters. Star clusters are groups of stars. Nebulae consist mainly of gas and dust. Both are usually found within galaxies. Compare sizes using the same units. Size ranges of different objects may overlap.

385.chn: 金星會由眉月變至近滿相。眉月時較近，視直徑較大。近滿相時較遠，視直徑較小。這符合金星繞太陽公轉的安排，與托勒密模型中金星一直位於地球和太陽之間的安排不符。木星的衛星繞木星運動，則顯示有些天體繞地球以外的天體運行。
385.eng: Venus shows phases from crescent to nearly full. It is nearer and has a larger apparent diameter when crescent-shaped, and farther with a smaller diameter when nearly full. This fits an orbit around the Sun, but not the Ptolemaic arrangement placing Venus always between Earth and the Sun. Jupiter's moons show that some celestial bodies orbit objects other than Earth.

386.chn: 恆星外層氣體吸收特定波長，再向各方向發射，使觀察方向上的這些波長強度下降，形成暗線。不同元素有各自的譜線組合，因此可辨認恆星外層氣體的元素。
386.eng: Gas in a star's outer layers absorbs particular wavelengths and re-emits in all directions, reducing their intensity along the observer's line of sight and producing dark lines. Each element has characteristic line patterns, allowing outer-atmosphere elements to be identified.

387.chn: 每種元素都有特定的一組譜線波長，因此可把未知樣本的發射線或吸收線位置與已知元素比較，以辨認所含元素。發射光譜中的亮線和同種元素吸收光譜中的暗線會出現在相應波長。判斷時應比對整組線的位置，不能只比較線的數目或亮暗。下圖例子中樣本 A 的發射線包含氫和氦，樣本 B 的吸收線對應碳。
387.eng: Compare an unknown sample's line wavelengths with known elemental patterns. Bright emission and dark absorption lines of the same element occur at corresponding wavelengths. Match the positions of the whole set rather than only line count or brightness. In the illustrated example, sample A's emission includes hydrogen and helium, while sample B's absorption matches carbon.

389.chn: 恆星光譜型由高温至低温排列為 O、B、A、F、G、K、M。赫羅圖中，温度通常由左至右降低，光度由下至上增加。若縱軸用絕對星等，數值越小，星體越亮。主序星由左上至右下分布。巨星和超巨星在較上方。白矮星在左下方，表示温度高、光度低、半徑小。
389.eng: Spectral types run O, B, A, F, G, K, M from hottest to coolest. In a typical H-R diagram, temperature decreases to the right and luminosity increases upwards. If the vertical axis uses absolute magnitude, smaller values mean brighter stars. The main sequence runs from upper left to lower right. Giants and supergiants lie higher. White dwarfs lie at lower left, showing high temperature, low luminosity and small radius.

393.chn: 尺寸縮小令表面積／體積比和表面原子比例增加，較多原子能與環境反應。蓮葉的納米毛狀結構排水，水滴滾走時帶走污物。
393.eng: Reducing size increases surface-area-to-volume ratio and the fraction of surface atoms available to interact with the surroundings. A lotus leaf's nanoscale surface structures repel water, allowing rolling droplets to carry dirt away.

394.chn:
二氧化鈦塗層有兩種自潔作用。紫外光協助分解有機污物；親水表面讓雨水鋪成水膜，把污物帶走。蓮葉的疏水表面則讓水形成水珠，滾走時帶走污物。

碳材料的性質取決於原子排列。下表比較四種同樣由碳組成、結構卻不同的材料。
394.eng:
Titanium-dioxide coatings clean in two ways. Ultraviolet light assists breakdown of organic dirt. The hydrophilic surface lets rain spread as a film and wash dirt away. A lotus leaf's hydrophobic surface instead forms droplets that carry dirt away as they roll.

Carbon materials show how atomic arrangement changes properties. The table compares four materials made from the same element but with different structures.

395.chn: 透射電子顯微鏡先由電子槍產生電子束，再用聚光磁透鏡，把電子束聚焦到很薄的樣本。電子穿過樣本後，經物鏡和投影透鏡形成放大影像，最後由螢光屏或相機記錄。樣本不同部位的電子透射程度不同，因此形成明暗對比。磁透鏡用磁場改變電子的運動方向。
395.eng: A transmission electron microscope first uses an electron gun to produce a beam. Condenser magnetic lenses focus it onto a thin sample. Transmitted electrons pass through objective and projector lenses to form an enlarged image, recorded on a screen or camera. Different parts of the sample transmit electrons differently, creating contrast. Magnetic lenses change electron directions using magnetic fields.

396.chn: 壓水式反應堆的燃料經核裂變釋放能量。控制棒吸收中子，調節連鎖反應。一次迴路的高壓水吸熱，作為冷卻劑，也作為減慢中子的減速劑。高壓使水在高温下保持液態。一次迴路經蒸汽發生器，把熱傳給獨立的二次迴路。二次迴路的蒸汽驅動渦輪和發電機，之後在冷凝器向外部冷卻迴路放熱，凝結成水，再循環使用。各迴路交換熱量，水則互不混合。
396.eng: Fission in the fuel releases energy. Control rods absorb neutrons to regulate the chain reaction. High-pressure water in the primary circuit removes heat and also acts as a moderator, slowing neutrons. Pressure keeps this water liquid at high temperature. The steam generator transfers heat to a separate secondary circuit. Its steam drives the turbine and generator, then gives up heat to an external cooling circuit in the condenser. The steam condenses to water for reuse. The circuits exchange heat while keeping their water separate.

397.chn:
半導體中的空穴，是本應有電子的位置缺少了電子；它在電流分析中表現為可移動的正電荷。n 型區以電子為主要載流子，p 型區以空穴為主要載流子，兩區相接形成 p–n 結。

LED 接正向直流電壓時，電子和空穴向接面移動並復合，能量減少後以電磁輻射釋出。材料的能量差決定光子的能量和發光顏色。
397.eng:
A hole is a missing electron in a semiconductor and behaves as a mobile positive charge carrier. Electrons are the majority carriers in an n-type region; holes are the majority carriers in a p-type region. Their boundary is a p–n junction.

Under forward d.c. bias, electrons and holes move towards the junction and recombine, releasing energy as electromagnetic radiation. The material's energy difference determines photon energy and emitted colour.

398.chn:
太陽能電池利用 p–n 結，把光能轉為電能。n 型區以電子為主要載流子，p 型區以空穴為主要載流子；空穴是缺少電子的位置，表現為正載流子。

光在接面附近產生電子和空穴，接面的電場把兩者分開，電子移向 n 型區，空穴移向 p 型區。接上負載後，電子可經外電路流動，傳統電流方向與電子流動相反。
398.eng:
A solar cell uses a p–n junction to convert light into electrical energy. Electrons are the majority carriers on the n-side and holes on the p-side. A hole is a missing electron that acts as a positive carrier.

Light generates electrons and holes near the junction. Its electric field separates them, moving electrons towards the n-side and holes towards the p-side. With a load connected, electrons flow through the external circuit; conventional current is opposite.

399.chn: 設陽光在垂直於光線方向的功率密度為 I，太陽能板面積為 A。θ 是光線與板面法線的夾角，投影面積便是 \(A\cos\theta\)，入射功率為 \(P=IA\cos\theta\)。垂直入射時，\(\theta=0\)，功率最大。若角度從板面量起，改用 \(\sin\theta\)。若題目已給出板面實際接收的功率密度，直接乘 A 即可。求電輸出功率時，再乘轉換效率。
399.eng: For sunlight intensity I measured perpendicular to its rays, a panel of area A intercepts projected area \(A\cos\theta\), where θ is the angle from the panel normal. Incident power is \(P=IA\cos\theta\), greatest at normal incidence when \(\theta=0\). If the angle is measured from the panel surface, use sine instead. If actual power per panel area is already given, multiply by A without another angle factor. Electrical output also includes conversion efficiency.

400.chn: 太陽能電池表面的透明減反射膜可減少光在表面反射，讓更多入射光進入電池並被吸收，從而提高可供轉換的光能。表面反射減少也使太陽能板看起來較暗。
400.eng: A transparent anti-reflection coating reduces reflected light, allowing more incident light into the cell for absorption and energy conversion. Reduced reflection also makes panels appear darker.

401.chn: 質量 m 的水在時間 t 內升温 ΔT，且沒有物態改變時，吸收的有用熱量為 \(Q=mc\Delta T\)。有用加熱功率為 \(P_{\mathrm{useful}}=\frac{mc\Delta T}{t}\)。若效率為 η，由「效率＝有用輸出／總輸入」，可得輸入功率 \(P_{\mathrm{input}}=\frac{mc\Delta T}{\eta t}\)。計算前把分鐘換成秒，並統一質量及比熱容量單位。有熱散失時，水得到的功率小於電器輸入功率。
401.eng: For water of mass m warmed by ΔT in time t with no state change, useful heat is \(Q=mc\Delta T\) and useful power is \(P_{\mathrm{useful}}=\frac{mc\Delta T}{t}\). With efficiency η, input power is \(P_{\mathrm{input}}=\frac{mc\Delta T}{\eta t}\), since efficiency is useful output divided by input. Convert minutes to seconds and use consistent mass and specific-heat units. With losses, water heating power is lower than appliance input power.

402.chn: 課本比較表指出低發射率玻璃和隔熱膜主要反射紅外及紫外，同時讓大部分可見光進入。可見光提供自然照明，減少不需要的熱輻射則降低熱增益。
402.eng: The textbook comparison describes glazing and films that preferentially reflect infrared and ultraviolet while transmitting much visible light. Visible transmission provides natural lighting, while reducing unwanted thermal radiation lowers heat gain.

403.chn: 混合動力車可由引擎、電動機或兩者一起驅動。課本例子中，加速或上斜時兩者同用，電動機分擔負載，可容許使用較小的引擎。這描述驅動時的動力分工。減速時的再生制動，則把部分動能轉回電能。
403.eng: A hybrid can be driven by its engine, motor or both. The textbook example uses both during acceleration or uphill travel, and motor assistance can permit a smaller engine. This division of propulsion differs from regenerative braking, which recovers energy during deceleration. Match the mechanism to the operating stage.

405.chn: 可再生能源可在人類使用的時間尺度內持續補充，例如太陽能、風能和水力。不可再生能源來自有限、難以在短時間補回的資源，例如煤、石油、天然氣和常用核燃料。分類依據是資源能否補充。核電運作時的碳排放較少，但仍使用有限的核燃料。
405.eng: Renewable sources replenish on timescales comparable to human use, including solar, wind and hydropower. Non-renewable resources are finite and not quickly replaced, including coal, oil, natural gas and conventional nuclear fuels. Replenishment, not carbon emissions during generation, determines the classification. Nuclear power still uses finite fuel despite comparatively low operating carbon emissions.

406.chn: 課本標籤例子把能源表現分為 1–5 級，1 級最高效，5 級最低。它也用耗電量和運行時間推算輸入功率。級別與總耗電量是不同資料。比較時按題目提供的產品分類及標籤條件判斷。
406.eng: The textbook's energy-label example uses grades 1–5, with grade 1 most efficient and grade 5 least efficient. Energy use and operating time can also be used to calculate input power. Efficiency grade and total electricity consumption are different pieces of information. Compare within the product category and conditions provided in the question.

407.chn: 同一條等響曲線表示主觀響度相同，但各頻率需要的 dB 值不同。讀圖時固定頻率向上找聲級，再看落在哪條曲線。若各頻率都增加相同 dB，應逐點重新讀圖，不能直接說主觀響度增加量相同。
407.eng: Points on one equal-loudness curve sound equally loud even though different frequencies require different decibel levels. At the specified frequency and level, identify the curve passing through the point. If all frequencies increase by the same dB amount, reread each point. This does not automatically give the same perceived loudness increase.

408.chn: A 掃描用尖峰顯示超聲回波。尖峰的橫向位置表示到達時間，高度表示信號強度。聲速為 c、來回時間為 t 時，界面深度是 \(\frac{ct}{2}\)。B 掃描把到達時間轉為位置，把信號強度轉為亮度，再組合多條掃描線，形成二維截面。影像可連續更新，顯示實時變化。較暗的區域表示收到的回波較弱，仍須配合其他資料解讀。
408.eng: An A-scan displays echo peaks: horizontal position gives arrival time and height gives signal strength. At sound speed c, interface depth is \(\frac{ct}{2}\) because the pulse travels out and back. A B-scan converts arrival time to position and strength to brightness, combining scan lines into a two-dimensional section that can update in real time. A dark region means weaker received echoes, not necessarily absent tissue or disease.

409.chn: 選成像方法時，先確定觀察目標：器官內表面、組織截面，或實時動作。再比較穿透能力、視野、侵入性和是否使用致電離輻射。超聲可顯示實時影像，也不使用致電離輻射，但不易穿過骨和含氣部位。光纖內窺鏡可直接看可到達的空腔內表面，並可取樣，但須插入器械，視野和可到達範圍有限。按目標器官和檢查目的，選擇合適的方法。
409.eng: First decide whether the target is an accessible internal surface, a tissue section or real-time movement. Then compare penetration, field of view, invasiveness and ionising radiation. Ultrasound is non-ionising and can show live movement, but passes poorly through bone and gas. Fibre-optic endoscopy directly views accessible cavities and can take samples, but requires insertion and has limited reach and view. Relate each limitation to the specified target and purpose.

410.chn: 內窺鏡可直接觀察可到達的器官內表面，也可經通道放入小工具取樣。視野和可到達範圍有限。某些檢查須先禁食或使用麻醉。檢查亦有穿孔、污染等風險。
410.eng: Endoscopy directly views accessible internal organ surfaces and can pass small sampling tools through a channel. Its view and reach are limited. Some procedures require preparation such as fasting or anaesthesia, and risks include perforation or contamination.

411.chn: 影像矩陣表示橫向和縱向的像素數。正方形像素的面積為 a 時，邊長是 \(\sqrt a\)。把影像寬度 W、高度 H 和像素邊長換成同一單位，再分別相除，矩陣便是 \(\frac{W}{\sqrt a}\times\frac{H}{\sqrt a}\)。兩個方向的像素數相乘，得到總像素數。例如 1024×1024 表示每邊有 1024 個像素，共 1,048,576 個。
411.eng: An image matrix states horizontal and vertical pixel counts. For square pixels of area a, side length is \(\sqrt a\). Express image width W, height H and pixel size in matching units. The matrix is \(\frac{W}{\sqrt a}\times\frac{H}{\sqrt a}\). Multiply the counts for total pixels. A 1024 × 1024 matrix contains 1,048,576 pixels; 1024 is not a physical side length.

413.chn: 空氣到角膜的界面提供眼睛最多的折射，這部分不能調節。晶狀體則可以改變形狀及焦距，讓不同距離物體清晰成像於視網膜。
413.eng: The air-cornea boundary provides most of the eye's refraction and is not adjustable. The crystalline lens changes shape and focal length to focus objects at different distances on the retina.

414.chn: 吸收劑量 D 是每千克物質吸收的輻射能量，單位為 Gy。同樣的吸收劑量，不同輻射可產生不同生物效應。等效劑量 H 把各種輻射的吸收劑量乘相應加權因子 w，再相加：\(H=\sum wD\)，單位為 Sv。課本採用 α 的 w＝20，β、γ 的 w＝1。有效劑量則再考慮不同組織的權重。
414.eng: Absorbed dose D is energy absorbed per kilogram, measured in Gy. Equal absorbed doses of different radiation types can have different biological effects. Equivalent dose sums doses multiplied by radiation weighting factors: \(H=\sum wD\), in Sv. The textbook uses w = 20 for alpha and w = 1 for beta and gamma. Effective dose additionally accounts for tissue weighting.

415.chn: 固定體積和氣體量時，壓強 p 與攝氏温度 θ 近似呈直線關係：\(p=m\theta+b\)。由兩個數據點可求斜率 \(m=\frac{p_2-p_1}{\theta_2-\theta_1}\)。把直線延長至 p＝0，橫軸截距 \(\theta_0=-\frac{b}{m}\) 就是實驗推算的絕對零度。這是量測範圍外的外推。課本數據得 −265 °C，與公認值約 −273 °C 有差異。作答時按實驗數據計算，並考慮誤差。
415.eng: At fixed gas amount and volume, pressure p varies approximately linearly with Celsius temperature θ: \(p=m\theta+b\). Two points give the slope \(m=\frac{p_2-p_1}{\theta_2-\theta_1}\). Extend the line to zero pressure. The intercept \(\theta_0=-\frac{b}{m}\) is the experimental estimate of absolute zero. This is extrapolation beyond the measured range. The textbook data give −265 °C rather than the accepted approximately −273 °C. Calculate from the supplied data and consider experimental error.

416.chn: 讀數前先停止加熱，充分攪拌水浴，使各處温度較均勻，再等温度穩定。攪拌減小水浴各處的温差。等候則讓樣本與水浴接近熱平衡。温度計須避免碰到燒杯底。
416.eng: Stop heating and stir the water bath thoroughly, making its temperature more uniform. Then wait for a steady reading. Stirring reduces temperature differences across the bath. Waiting lets the sample and bath approach thermal equilibrium. Keep the thermometer away from the beaker bottom.

417.chn:
交流發電機把機械能轉為電能。線圈兩端各接一個滑環（匯電環）。滑環是兩個互相絕緣的完整金屬圓環，並各自經碳電刷連接外電路。

線圈在磁場中轉動，感生電動勢每半圈反向。滑環始終保持線圈兩端與相應電刷的連接，不會像換向器那樣交換連接，因此線圈和外電路的電流都每半圈反向，輸出交流電。
417.eng: An a.c. generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy. Each coil end connects to one slip ring. These are two complete metal rings, insulated from each other, each connected to the external circuit through its own carbon brush. As the coil rotates in a magnetic field, its induced e.m.f. reverses every half-turn. Slip rings maintain each coil end's connection to its respective brush, without swapping connections as a commutator does. The current in both the coil and external circuit therefore reverses every half-turn, producing a.c.

418.chn:
摩擦力阻礙兩個接觸面的相對滑動，或相對滑動的趨勢。已滑動時是滑動摩擦；接觸處未滑動而有滑動趨勢時是靜摩擦。判斷方向時，先想像沒有摩擦力，接觸面會往哪邊相對滑動，摩擦力便向相反方向。

斜面上靜止的物體有下滑趨勢，所以摩擦力沿斜面向上。驅動輪向後推地面時，地面對輪胎的靜摩擦力向前。隨水平平台轉動而未滑動的物體，靜摩擦力可指向圓心，提供向心合力。
418.eng:
Friction opposes relative sliding, or the tendency of relative sliding, between contacting surfaces. Sliding friction acts when they slide; static friction acts when the contact does not slide. To find direction, imagine how the surfaces would slide relative to one another without friction. Friction opposes that tendency.

A stationary object on a slope tends to slide down, so friction acts up the slope. A driven tyre pushes the ground backwards and receives forward static friction. For an object rotating with a horizontal platform without slipping, static friction can point towards the centre and provide centripetal force.

419.chn:
彈性物體被拉長、壓縮或彎曲時，可把能量儲存為彈性勢能。物體回復原狀時，儲存的能量可轉為動能或其他形式。

例如，救生網或蹦床被向下壓時，落下物體的動能和重力勢能可轉為網或床的彈性勢能；回彈時，彈性勢能再轉為物體的動能。實際過程也可能有內能和聲音等能量轉移。
419.eng:
An elastic object can store energy as elastic potential energy when stretched, compressed or bent. As it returns towards its original shape, this energy can become kinetic energy or other forms.

For example, a falling object's kinetic and gravitational potential energies can be stored as elastic potential energy when a safety net or trampoline stretches. During rebound, stored energy becomes kinetic energy again. A real process can also transfer energy to internal energy and sound.
